As each day passes, babies' awareness of the world around them -- and all the wonders it holds -- continues to develop. Wild animals are especially intriguing and World Animals captures the spirtit of little ones' fascination with wild creatures as it introduces them to animals living in the jungle, in the ocean, and on the savannah.

Babies love animals, and now you can bring animals from the seven continents home to your baby. Beloved Bondi lifeguard Maxi risks his life to rescue two fishermen from an overturned boat in challenging seas. Jethro is angry after rescuing tourists he had warned about rips, then later collapses on the beach. Luke Daniels rides a wave using the oldest surfboard design in the world.

Newbie Max paddles 600 metres to reach a lone swimmer treading water near shark nets. Lifeguards attend to skate park injuries, and newbie Tyson tests his skate skills with a pro. Lifeguards Jackson and John both attend to a woman struggling in the surf.

On the hottest day ever in Bondi, tempers flare in the heat and a fight erupts on the beach. A blistering Northwest wind sweeps a couple and their boogie board half a kilometre out to sea. Terry encounters a man in excruciating pain after losing his boardies.

Tragedy unfolds as a Chinese backpacker is left comatose after-hours. A father loses his son in a massive crowd. Lifeguards struggle communicating with the distressed Cambodian man. Former ironman Kailan Collins shares the details of his rare injury for the first time in seventeen years.

Heidi Klum joins Bondi's celebrity roll call. But will the lifeguards look up to scratch when they appear in her latest photo shoot? In the water, Harrison faces an impossible choice: one lifeguard, three drowning swimmers. In the lifeguard tower, a severely dislocated knee gets emergency surgery.
Kite surfers make the most of the wild conditions when the biggest storm of the season hits Bondi. Chappo and Jack race to help a man with agonising chest pains, and Harries confronts a body surfer.

Russian body builder Dimitri breaks both legs after he plunges down the cliff at North Bondi. A learner paddleboarder snaps her collar bone in the shore break. And Chappo's rescue skills in the South Corner earn him the title 'Chappo's Corner'. But one veteran lifeguard is having none of it.

Amidst the bustling crowds at Bondi, two men start drowning at the north end. Californian bodybuilder Ike Catcher arrives to challenge Harries for the 'King-of-Bondi' title. The real King-of-Bondi test is the annual lifeguard challenge, when everyone races to decide which lifeguard is the fastest.

Hundreds of Dutch tourists hit Bondi for a New Years swim - straight in to Backpackers Rip. A diabetic comes to the tower with low blood sugar, and then suffers an epileptic fit. Troy uses the Lifeguard security camera to identify a group of bag thieves operating on Bondi.

A rough tackle brings a game of beach gridiron to a halt. A messy incident occurs on the promenade. Harrison faces karma for dismissing bluebottle victims, as he ends up paddling through a swarm himself. Humbled, he's reluctant to seek rescue and is later tasked with removing a rat from the skate bowl.

After 10 years of service, Maxi bids farewell to full-time lifeguarding to pursue his childhood dream of becoming a firefighter. Using his recent training, Maxi responds to a tunnel fire at North Bondi. Harrison and Jethro attend to a girl found facedown with no pulse. A German tourist has a dislocated shoulder.

New trainee Jethro earns praise from senior lifeguards for rescuing a man more than double his size, but his fortunes reverse when he accidentally locks himself in the lifeguard tower and struggles to find a way out. Later he is faced with a woman found barely alive at the bottom of the cliffs.

A severe heatwave ends abruptly with Bondi experiencing the biggest hailstorm in 20 years. Harrison makes a daring move to save members of a Korean tour group caught in a rip. Reidy attempts to become the greatest Bondi Santa and the lifeguards receive a special Christmas gift from a local legend.

In soaring temperatures, a 2-year-old girl is trapped in a locked car. A mother and daughter are saved by a man who can barely swim himself. Lifeguards catch a bag thief, who sends them on a chase. Harrison must improvise for equipment when he spots swimmers going under after pack-up time.
The boys try conquer their fear of sharks, but diving with great whites may only make things worse. And tragedy strikes, as lifeguards must recover the body of a young man found dead in the surf.

In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Jaein comforts Minwoo as he struggles with guilt over a patient's death, and Minwoo decides to apply for an internship at the hospital. On their very first day as interns, Minwoo and Jaein are ordered by Inhyuk to transfer a critically ill patient to another hospital under emergency conditions.

Just as the team breathes a sigh of relief after stabilizing a critically ill VIP patient's bleeding, an offhand question from Minwoo prompts Inhyuk to re-operate and open the patient's abdomen once more. Meanwhile, knowing well of Sunwoo's unfaithful ways, Minwoo tries to keep Jaein from seeing Sunwoo, who has been rushed to the ER after an accident.

As department heads at Sejung Hospital clamor to have Sunwoo admitted to their own units, the residents are left confused and overwhelmed. A new notice is issued declaring that all surgical cases must be handled by the on-call surgeon, and Euna watches with concern as Inhyuk exits the operating room.

After Inhyuk completes the surgery, both sides scramble to prepare for an impending disciplinary hearing—the ER staff on one side, and the department heads on the other, each holding urgent strategy meetings. Meanwhile, when the guardian of a patient complaining of abdominal pain aggressively demands discharge, Minwoo allows the patient to leave.

When the surgery schedule for a high school girl injured in a traffic accident falls into chaos, everyone can't help but miss Choi Inhyuk's presence, while Minwoo sinks into self-doubt. Meanwhile, a clue surfaces about the whereabouts of a patient discharged with suspected bowel perforation, and Jaein stands her ground without hesitation—even in the face of threats from gangsters.

Thanks to Jaein and Minwoo, Jiyoung undergoes surgery successfully and later posts a heartfelt message of gratitude on the hospital website, earning Minwoo recognition as a “Kindness Award” staff member. Meanwhile, Inhyuk, who has submitted his resignation and begun searching for a new job, witnesses another traffic accident unfold right before his eyes.

Seoyeong meets her dad for the first time in 3 years. But she's still as cold and unforgiving to him as ever. Meanwhile, Samjae gets depressed from the meeting and Seoyeong tries to begin her life over.

Ujae meets Samjae and Sangu and finally begins to understand... But the greatest thing he learns is that just because he forgives Seoyeong and understands her, it doesn't mean she'll find the love she once had for him again... Perhaps it's all too late now...

Seoyeong gets her divorce and begins to live her new life... Seongjae asks Director Yun to leave. Seoyeong goes to tell her dad she's sorry for what she did but they are yet to patch things up... Hojeong gets over her greatest fear that Sangu will dump her now.

Seoyeong gets her first client which is none other than Ujae! He's doing his best to make it up to her for the misunderstanding. Seoyeong spends her birthday with her friends only to get caught by Ujae in the end.
Ujae continues to work hard to get on Seoyeong's good side... Seongjae's unsuccessful with his first debut... And Jiseon continues to get closer to the magician to get a huge shock at the end.

The family celebrate Seollal... Gangsun's still alone and Jiseon decides to call it quits with Gibeom... It seems for real this time. Seoyeong visit home and says hello to her mother for the first time in 3 years... She seems to be getting closer and closer to Ujae.

To use Nokyoung's spirit daughter Wol as a human talisman, she is abducted. As Wol attempts to escape, she receives help from Yangmyung—yet fails to recognize him. Dragged into the palace, Wol is forced to enter Hwon's bedchamber as a shaman meant to absorb misfortune.

Upon awakening, Hwon fiercely interrogates Wol, demanding to know who sent her—yet finds himself strangely preoccupied with the shaman. Hearing of Wol's presence, Bogyeong instinctively senses an ominous threat closing in.

Sensing Hwon's inner turmoil, Woon delivers Wol's letter to him. Drawn to the handwriting and phrasing that feel hauntingly familiar, Hwon finds himself shaken. Meanwhile, Bogyeong detects the strange tension between Hwon and the shaman, and Queen Dowager Yoon orders that the consummation date be moved forward.

When Nokyoung warns Yangmyung not to form any emotional ties with Wol, he pushes back fiercely. Determined to resolve the growing chaos, Wol announces her intention to leave Seongsucheong. At the same time, Hwon discovers troubling inconsistencies in Yeonwoo's final letter.

Having resolved to leave Seongsucheong, Wol asks Nokyoung for one last chance to see Hwon, unable to push him from her thoughts. Meanwhile, Bogyeong learns from Queen Dowager Han that the date for her consummation with Hwon has been set.

On the night Hwon is to consummate his marriage with Bogyeong, he collapses after being struck by an unknown curse. Seizing the moment, Bogyeong schemes to place the blame on Wol. Seeking the truth behind Yeonwoo's death, Hong Gyu-tae visits a physician, while Wol is falsely accused and dragged to the State Tribunal.

programmes.st: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programmes.d: Sonic outsmarts Coconuts, then stumbles into a Convention of Bounty Hunter Robots where Robotnik puts a price on his head. After Sonic defeats all the Robot Bounty Hunters, Robotnik creates Scratch and Grounder to be his S.S.S.S.S. Squad.

Sonic and Tails find an underground world of diamonds, but they are held captive there by a miserly Mole-Troll. When Robotnik comes to capture them, he accidently frees them from the Mole-Troll, who teams up with Sonic and Tails to defend his riches.

Sonic saves a damsel in distress, and falls in love with her, not knowing she's a robot built by Robotnik. But when she has a chance to trap him, she helps him escape, realizing she has fallen for him.

When Scratch and Grounder use Robotnik's new Slo-Mo Ray Gun to capture Sonic, Tails rescues him by reversing the gun and turning it on a tribe of friendly Tree Sloth People who become a high speed commando strike force against Robotnik.

Tails and other Mobius citizens are lured into Robotnik's robotic games of chance, and when they lose they're sent to slave labor camps. Sonic rescues Tails and the others by beating the house in games of chance at Robotnik's Casino.
In order to free Sketch Lampoon (a satirical comic book artist) from Robotnik's new high security prison, Sonic allows himself to be captured, then makes a high speed rescue and escape.

When Tails gets trapped in the "Warp of Confusion" (an Escher-like world of another dimension) by Robotnik's cousin, Dr. Warpnik, Sonic comes to the rescue and traps Robotnik and his badniks in the warp.

programmes.st: Close Encounter of the Sonic Kind
programmes.d: Sonic and Tails befriend a pair of aliens who crash land their spaceship on Mobius. Sonic has to avoid Robotnik's ULTRA-GRAVITIZER (sort of a hedgehog flypaper) to help fix their ship and blast-off back home.

Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

When a simple tune Cherry composes goes viral on the Berryweb, Cherry quickly gets fed up with everyone listening to this song, everywhere, all the time. She goes to comic lengths to get some peace so she can compose the song she's suppose to write for the Queen of Berryvania.

Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. Strawberry good-naturedly chuckles at her antics. But Orange gets her dander up and wades into the water to face her "attacker." When she looks down into the water, gazing up at her is the cutest, most adorable, puffy-cheeked fish she's ever seen. It's love at first sight. Orange has to take him home.

At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.

Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon  it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programmes.st: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programmes.d: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programmes.st: The WoodHaven Way - "Early Season in Kansas
programmes.d: Kansas is known for producing world-class whitetails, and Colten Scroggins of The Fever Crew head to the Sunflower State to hunt with our good friends at Triple H Outfitters. After drawing an early season youth rifle tag, Colten has one goal in mind, tagging a true Kansas giant.

programmes.st: The WoodHaven Way - "The Legend of Forky
programmes.d: Every great hunting property has a buck that becomes part of its history. In 2017, that buck was "Forky" for Pat Reeve of Driven Hunter. Just days before Minnesota's archery opener, Forky began regularly visiting a strategically placed waterhole, giving Pat the confidence that opening weekend could be something special. With months of preparation leading up to the season, everything came down to being in the right tree at the right time.

Late October is one of the best times of the season to make a move, and Owen Reigler with Midwest Whitetail did just that on a great Iowa buck he calls the 6x6. With an active scrape line, an untouched clover plot, and a good idea of how the buck was using the area, Owen puts together the pieces for a perfect late-October setup.

Three years of patience came down to one perfect evening. Alex Rahman with Prime Ridge Outdoors has watched a buck he calls “Lopsided Larry” for the past three seasons, patiently waiting and giving the deer time to reach his full potential. Heading into 2025, the wait was finally over, and Larry became Alex's #1 target for the season.

A scientist from the original Commonwealth shows up, caught in a time loop.
Flavin returns, sparking a gang war, and helps Dylan develop as a Paradine.
A crystal that can restore the Andromeda's power is discovered, but in order to get it, Dylan must work for the mine's owner - who uses slave labor.
Tunnels are discovered on Seefra which can be used to reach eight other Seefra planets.
When an old man is killed, Beka, Rhade, and Harper are the main suspects and stand trial.
Rhade leads the rebels in a battle against a warlord on Seefra-5. A scientist previously thought dead helps Harper rebuild the quantum teleporter.
Dylan discovers that Beka's boyfriend was really Drago Musevini, and he used Beka's DNA to create the Nietzscheans. She is their Alpha Matriarch.
Beka and Rhade find a test that will either grant them great wealth or drive them to madness.
Harper discovers a program built into the Seefra system that can destroy eight of the planets, likely as a defense mechanism. Trance tries to stop this.
While Harper works on a way to save the Seefra system, a spy sneaks aboard Andromeda and attacks Beka.

When Dylan is badly injured in a lab explosion, he travels through a series of alternate realities.
Rommie is rebuilt to help evacuate the Seefra system.
A warlord convinces his followers that the approaching destruction of the outer planets is a plot to make it easier to loot their planet.

programmes.st: Chaos and the Stillness of It
programmes.d: Dylan, Rhade, and Beka work together to rescue Trance from Methus-2 and Harper from General Burma.
The crew finally makes it out of the Seefra system, and discover Dylan is the last Paradine; the World Ship wasn't destroyed, and Nietzscheans have begun their plan to destroy Earth.
In the series finale, the final battle to save the New Systems Commonwealth begins.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Rohan Kishibe's Adventure
programmes.d: Koichi and Rohan discover a small alley that does not appear to be listed anywhere on the map. The two decide to go into the alley to see where it leads but soon find themselves walking around in circles and unable to get out.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 1
programmes.d: Josuke and Okuyasu become friends with a Stand user named Shigekiyo Yangu, a.k.a. Shigechi, who can use his Stand to find and collect the money that is scattered across town. Impressed by the boy’s abilities.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and friends try to cash in the winning lottery ticket they found. However, the bank clerk is not convinced they’re the actual owners of the ticket, placing the three teens into a tough spot as they try to talk their way through their big lie.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yukako Yamagishi Dreams of Cinderella
programmes.d: Yukako, depressed because she can’t get Koichi to return her feelings, comes across a beauty salon where the owner claims a special beauty treatment will help customers find love and happiness…

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 1
programmes.st: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 1
programmes.d: A man named Yoshikage Kira is enjoying his lunch break at the park with a sandwich in hand. But his peaceful afternoon is cut short when Shigechi accidentally takes Kira’s sandwich bag, believing it to be his own.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 2
programmes.st: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 2
programmes.d: Yoshikage Kira is revealed to be the serial killer who’s been lurking in Morioh, and a Stand user as well. Having discovered his secret, Shigechi tries to fight off Kira with his Harvest, only to suffer fatal wounds from the killer’s Stand, Deadly Queen

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Heart Attack, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and Koichi come under the attack of Yoshikage Kira’s Stand bomb, called Heart Attack. Narrowly escaping the blast, Koichi tries to go after the serial killer but is stopped by Jotaro, who tells him to focus on dealing with the Stand bomb first.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Heart Attack, Part 2
programmes.d: Kira is forced to appear before Koichi after his remote Heart Attack bomb is made useless by the boy’s new Stand, Reverb Act 3. Finally coming face-to-face with the serial killer, Koichi attacks him with Act 3.
Josuke and his friends are at Yoshikage Kira’s home trying to find any clues that may lead them to the serial killer, who has gone into hiding under a new face and identity.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Janken Boy Is Coming!
programmes.d: Kira’s father, Yoshihiro, begins searching for Stand users who would help protect his son from his pursuers. Meanwhile, Rohan is taking photos at the train station when he is suddenly challenged to a game of rock-paper-scissors.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: I'm an Alien
programmes.d: While on their way to school, Josuke and Okuyasu find a young man lying unconscious in the middle of what appears to be a crop circle.  When they try to take a closer look, the man suddenly wakes up and starts claiming he’s an alien from outer space.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Highway Go Go, Part 1
programmes.d: Rohan is convinced that Josuke is cheating in their game of Cee-lo when all the dice rolls in his opponent’s favor. Feeling insulted, Rohan stabs his own finger and swear he’ll find out how Josuke is cheating in their next round.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Highway Go Go, Part 2
programmes.d: Rohan sacrifices himself to save Josuke from a remote-controlled Stand that sucks nutrients out of its victims. Moved by Rohan’s act of bravery, Josuke races through town to find and defeat the Stand’s user before it can kill Rohan.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Cats Love Yoshikage Kira
programmes.d: Shinobu tells her husband, Kosaku, that she saw a stray cat in their basement with a hole in its throat. When Kosaku goes down to take a look, he finds the cat already dead, The next morning, a strange plant sprouts from the spot where the cat was buried.

Yoshihiro Kira spots Kosaku Kawajiri and instantly recognizes that it’s actually his son, Yoshikage. Meanwhile, Josuke, Okuyasu, and Mikitaka find a strange man living in an abandoned electrical tower.

Yuki decides that as Guardian, she must protect all the students at the academy and fight Rido.

programmes.st: A Matter Of Life And Breath
programmes.d: Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

Linda makes plans with Philip and Will, but she cancels her plans with Philip.
Philip goes to Danny and asks if he can date his mother.

programmes.st: I Don't See You That Way
programmes.d: Philip treats Linda to a romantic dinner.
Phillip admits his feelings for Linda and the two share a romantic kiss with each other.
Linda is troubled by the kiss she shared with Philip and Will overhears.
Danny swears off condiments; Hattie mishears him.
Philip's playing cards with the group; Linda's surprised when Will also shows up at the house.
Linda and Phillip are caught with their tongues tied; Will breaks up with Linda.
Linda doesn't react well after Will dumps her.
Danny, Floyd, Sam, and Drew have been temporarily evicted; Danny asks Hattie if they can crash with her.
Philip moves on; Will apologizes to Linda.
Suzanne becomes the subject to Nick's joke-off, and Suzanne retaliates against him.

KP and Tim are disappointed to learn that their artists were at Barbie and Danielle's pop-up shop. During a team tattoo lesson with Cory, Nessie explains how she and the other women in the shop were passed over by KP for a potential client.

Barbie opens up to Dani about relationship issues and pushes Bone to make amends with her father. After suffering a personal loss, Ink is surprised to find out that Vudu and Nessie quit IAM. At the IAM grand opening, Star drops some big news on KP and Tim

KP, Nessie, Lemeir and Star each discuss what went down during pre-COVID filming that led to the current drama. Nessie reveals tension with KP stemming from his unwillingness to hire her ex. Self-promoting at the Pasadena Tattoo Convention causes a rift.

The IAM team holds auditions in search of new artists. Tensions rise when Armani reveals who Star was hanging out with and a major decision is made regarding her future. Barbie confronts Bone about his cheating. Nessie is shocked when a celeb client calls

programmes.st: So Much For A Mental Health Day
programmes.d: Chaos ensues when the 125th artists merge with the Brooklyn shop. A startling revelation about Rok causes Ted and Puma to panic. Bux makes the situation with Spyder worse. Ceaser announces an out-of-town trip and Tatti goes MIA.

The crew heads to Orlando for Black Ink boot camp where Ceaser is ready to see who is really there for Black Ink. Everyone gets put to the test as tensions arise when Bux and Spyder air their unfinished business at dinner.

The crew is left in disarray after the bar fight. Ceaser and the bosses wonder what this means for the future of Black Ink, while Rok and Krystal's plans to open a Black Ink New Jersey come to a screeching halt.
While Ted and Puma address the fallout from Orlando, Tatti starts her new life post Black Ink. Bae attempts to make amends with Krystal as Rok decides whether he's more loyal to Krystal or Black Ink.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Welcome to Harlem, U.S.A.
programmes.d: On the corner of 113th and Lennox, in the heart of Harlem, you'll find the Black Ink Crew and all of their crazy antics. Presented by VH1.

Caesar is fed up with O'S**t's unprofessionalism and makes a decision that will send the Black Ink Crew spinning out of control. Puma receives shocking news while at a strip club and is forced to consider tough changes ahead. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew You got served, son!
programmes.d: Sassy contemplates leaving the chaos of the shop for more stability. Puma discovers O'S**t's life has spiraled out of control since being fired. Alex's feelings for Ted come at the cost of her friendship with Dutchess and Sassy. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Baby Mama Drama
programmes.d: Dutchess drives Caesar to court where he may end up serving time in jail for owing back child support. Sassy takes a terrified Puma to get a new tooth. Presented by VH1.
Black Ink throws a birthday party for Sassy that turns into an out of control Mixxxy bash and all hell breaks loose. Dutchess goes ballistic after Alex hits on Caesar. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew What Happens in Vegas…
programmes.d: The Black Ink Crew is heading to Vegas to be part of the biggest tattoo convention in the world. Alex has gone M.I.A. and the crew wonders if she is going to show up at all. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew This, That, and the Third
programmes.d: O'S**t is put in charge of the shop while Ceaser goes down South with Dutchess to meet her parents. When Alex finally arrives back at Black Ink, Dutchess has a few things to say to her. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew In the Dirty, Dirty
programmes.d: Down in North Carolina, Ceaser meets Dutchess's entire family and faces questions about marriage and kids. While there, Cease gets a call from Harlem and is surprised to hear that O'S**t's reign has come to an abrupt end. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew So Much on My Biscuit
programmes.d: Ceaser and Dutchess cut their trip short to pick up O'S**t from "The Barge," the New York City prison he has been locked up in for days. Alex and O'S**t face each other for the first time since the night he went to jail. Presented by VH1.

Frank must race to stop a biological weapon attack on New York City while keeping it a secret from his family during their most sentimental holiday, Mother's Day.
A dangerous criminal from Danny's past comes back to seek revenge and kidnaps Jackie. Meanwhile, Jamie meets his new partner.

When an injured woman recants her claim of domestic violence, Danny and Jackie look into it further, only to find that the woman is involved in a secret relationship with a high-powered councilman who also happens to be a friend of Frank's.
Danny believes a serial killer is on the loose when two separate murder victims are identified as members of a group charged with a gang rape.
Danny and Jackie set out to investigate the murder of a bride on her wedding day in a drive-by gang shooting.
When Erin's key witness, an infamous photographer, is nearly killed in a hit and run, she arranges for Danny to work protection detail to safeguard him.

Shortly after Frank awards a detective with the Medal of Valor for his undercover work for the NYPD in Malaysia, the detective is taken hostage by a Malaysian drug lord whose brother he helped put in prison.
When a knife-wielding attacker dressed as Baron Samedi, the Spirit of Death, stabs a man in costume on Halloween, Danny enters the world of voodoo.
Danny arrives at a college campus to find a murdered student, who was thought to be dealing drugs.
When two motorists driving gas-guzzling cars die at the hands of a sniper, Danny and Kate are put on the case of what the city believes is the work of a radical environmental serial killer.
When Danny and Kate come up empty-handed with leads for a shooting, Linda helps make a break in the case when she overhears the victim telling his priest who is responsible.
Jamie must deal with the emotional consequences of his actions on the job.
When Danny's car matches an NYPD description of a vehicle involved in a drug deal, he is stopped and taken into custody when a bag of cocaine is found in his trunk.
When a man with multiple rat bites is thrown from a moving car, Danny works the case to find out why and who was trying to send a message.

Before a Hasidic Grand Rebbe passes away, he chooses his youngest son to succeed him. But when the new appointee dies suddenly, Danny investigates the oldest son and others within the Hasidic community.
When a 10-year-old boy is the victim of an incident in the projects, Danny's heated approach to the case lands him in anger management class.
Erin and Danny investigate a cold case of a girl who was attacked by her rich and powerful boyfriend, who was never convicted.
The Ponderosa becomes a war zone when it is invaded by a detachment of Mexican mercenaries under General Diaz.
Joe is goaded into facing gunman Dan Taggert, unaware there is more to be prearranged than he realizes.
The Generation Gap, Western-style, as Hoss tries to bring a young man and his father closer together.

Clay Stafford signs on to work for the Cartwrights and shortly afterwards shoots and kills a man who accuses him of cheating at poker.  The miners warn Clay to leave town, but it appears he killed in self-defense.
Lafe Jessup doesn't really want to be married, and now he's about to be a father!  The horse wrangler finds a fight with Hoss at his reluctance to perform his duties.
While hunting for a wolf, Joe is attacked by the wolf.  Adam also hunting for the wolf, hears Joe struggling with the wolf comes to Joe's aid.
Adam, Hoss and Joe mistakenly believe their father was murdered.  They split into 3 different directions to confront the supposed killers.
Joe is bushwhacked in the desert and awakens to find himself in Martinville, a town that may or may not be populated by ghosts.  An eerie, surrealistic and well-produced episode.
A sailor, claiming to be one of Adam's closest friends, is given a warm welcome by the Cartwrights, who have no way of knowing the man and his accomplice plan on robbing them.
Adam takes a shine to Rebecca Kaufman, the daughter of a Jewish peddler, and bandits are convinced the Kaufman wagon is worth robbing.
Ben regrets that he helped Tom Slayden start a freight hauling business when Slayden sets out to ruin all the competition, and Joe is shot in the process.
Hoss decides to help out Wade Tyree and introduces him to Abigail and her daughter, Bonnie.  Hoss hopes this will stop Wade's constant drinking.
Ben becomes irritable and reckless when the completion of an important timber contract is hindered by an old rival.
One of the wealthiest men in the world, Charles Augustus Hackett, offers to buy the Ponderosa, price no object.  Ben says the ranch is not for sale and Hackett refuses to give up.
A conman heads into town and takes advantage of the Cartwrights with a fake land deal.  The conman ends up staying in Virginia city to run an orphanage.
Joe struggles to understand whether his friend was right in killing a dying man who pleaded to put out of his misery.
So the Cartwrights will not be killed, one of Ben's oldest friends must make sure Joe does not win a horse race.
Claw Marks left by Code are discovered just outside of the Leaf Village.
At Boro’s facility, Eida has awakened.
Kawaki worries that he won’t be able to protect Naruto or the village.
Due to the risk that Code might attempt to kill Boruto and Kawaki, guards are assigned to them.
Boruto arrives to help Kawaki defeat Code.
Code takes Shikamaru hostage, and in his desire to settle his grudge, Momoshiki joins him.
Boruto makes a desperate decision to prevent Momoshiki from taking over his consciousness again.
Boruto Uzumaki, the son of the village leader, saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on by bullies.
After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.
After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

programmes.st: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
programmes.d: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof.
A mysterious student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!
Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act.
A Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream, and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother's Hyuga Clan.
Under his father and grandfather's guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. No matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form.

programmes.st: The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
programmes.d: Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow "The Ghost" and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent "Ghost Incidents."
During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi Izuno and Namida Suzumeno get wrapped up in the Ghost Incident and are hurt.
The Ghost incidents suddenly come to an end and Boruto and his classmates are puzzled, but Mitsuki seems to know something they don't.
Seventh Hokage Naruto and his top advisors are shocked to learn who the perpetrator is from the results of Sai's investigation. Just then, Nue, an enormous otherworldly beast, appears!

programmes.st: The Path That Boruto Can See
programmes.d: The late Danzo Shimura was the founder and leader of the Foundation, an elite branch of the ANBU Black Ops. The recent incidents have been masterminded by someone who had sworn to carry on Danzo's wishes.
The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.
Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho.
The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit.
Boruto and his classmates head to the Village Hidden in the Mist in the Land of Water for a field trip.
Boruto and his classmates are invited to tour the Hidden Mist Academy under Kagura and Chojuro's escort.

After spending twelve years in prison for a rape, torture, and murder, a young punk returns to San Francisco to seek revenge against Mike Stone, who was the arresting officer.
A father finds out that the man who murdered his son is released on a technicality.

Maggie Wells, the secretary of a private investigator who was murdered, is on her way to see Joe Mannix. The cab driver taking her there fails to follow the route to Mannix' office, and then attempts to shoot her, but she is able to escape.
The president of a corporation reported lost at sea, secretly returns to Mannix claiming his small plane was sabotaged and to try to find out who tried to kill him.
Sun and Sky, the horse favored to win the Kentucky Derby and possibly the Triple Crown, is being shipped to Kentucky to participate in the upcoming race.

Peggy has an old friend named Eve Chancellor, whose husband Jim started on the police force at the same time as Peggy's late husband. Eve is concerned about her son Cap, who has dropped out of school.

Betty investigates an academy for girls where a series of accidents have injured instructors and students alike. What she finds is a vicious group of girls who dominate the school through fear and intimidation tactics.
J.R. investigates the disappearance of three women in a five week time period, and then gets involved with a psychic to help him when it looks like she might be his best chance of solving the case.

Betty goes undercover at a rehabilitation center for substance abuse addicts to investigate a suspicious death and discovers a sinister scheme where they administer dangerous drugs that keep patients coming back.

A beautiful disco dancer is harassed by numerous men from the disco where she dance's and her life is threatened. When her roommate is murdered she believes it was meant to be her and she asks J.R. to investigate.
Undercover cop murdered, McGarrett sends Officer Barnes to infiltrate drug-smuggling group led by Thomas Lynch. McGarrett has doubt but moves forward.
"Why are firms owned by virtuous Japanese-American Yuhio Muromoto being bombed by a WW2 memorabilia collector? McGarrett tries to uncover the truth.
Steve McGarrett is caught up in a series of puzzling murders immediately following the death of a famed artist whose estate seems to be the target of a killer.
A mystery writer examines strange occurrences in experiments with a cryogenics institute. (Cryogenics is the freezing of living material for preservation for future use.)
Luciana Paluzzi plays an international news reporter whose unwillingness to reveal her source for an impending kidnapping creates an international incident involving the Middle East.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: A nasty slumlord threatening to evict a single mother and her daughter is later suspected of murder, but Gillespie’s hands are tied as this is Sheriff McComb’s case. Meanwhile, Parker has a new speed gun and he’s become the most hated man in Sparta.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: The shooting of the campaign manager of a white supremacist politician appears to be a botched assassination attempt on the Senate candidate himself, but it soon reveals a web of deceit and betrayal. Was the assassination botched intentionally?
Hunter and McCall try to solve a bank robbery and murder, while attempting to cope with the double and triple-crossing schemes of a small time criminal.
When the husband of a policewoman is murdered, evidence of wife abuse makes Hunter and McCall suspect the woman's patrol partner who knew about the beatings.
A tense situation erupts into a hotbed of chaos! While awaiting treatment from Dr. Sloan, convicted criminal John Dunbar unexpectedly jumps his guards and seizes a gun.

A devastating earthquake causes widespread damage and Dr. Sloan's hospital goes on emergency power. After the tremors stop, Mark's friend Martin Garfield is found dead in the ruins of his mansion nearby. Was it the earthquake or murder?
Steve's undercover waterfront surveillance causes city-wide panic. His suspect, a gangland hit man, has suddenly developed the plague!

Escaped convicts seek shelter in a church while waiting for fake passports and money. One convict has a past relationship with the nuns in church. The nuns, as well as Alex and her women support group, are held captive by the convicts.
CD gets a job as acting Chief of Security at a Resort. When he asks his assistant, Grady what happened to his predecessor, Grady tells him that he had a drinking problem and disappeared.

A woman witnesses a murder and is on the run from the killer. She takes her son to stay with the boy's father who is a pro-wrestler struggling with his own problems. The Rangers try to find the woman to protect her.

A 6-year-old boy is mortally wounded during a late-night shootout in a residential neighborhood between the Rangers and two criminals; Trivette was involved in the shootout when the boy became caught in the crossfire.
David Janssen, who stars as Dr. Richard Kimble, is wounded by a deputy's bullet and finds refuge in an Indian school, but not for long.
The one-armed man hires a gunman to ambush Richard Kimble.
Kimble is mistakenly identified as the murderer of a neighborhood girl while working as an apartment building janitor in a slum.
MacGyver's old nemesis, Murdoc, uses an unsuspecting Penny Parker as bait in a bizarre plan to lure MacGyver into a trap.
MacGyver learns that Pete Thornton's son, Michael, is involved in an international espionage ring stealing secrets from the Phoenix Foundation.

programmes.st: The Battle Of Jimmy Giordano aka "…Tommy Giordano")
programmes.d: MacGyver intervenes in a war between two crime families to rescue the kidnapped son of a Phoenix Foundation lab technician.
Posing as a visiting missionary, Dr. Sloan goes undercover at a convent to reveal the location and contents of a most mysterious package - a parcel that brought its owner to a sudden, untimely death.
It's double trouble for Dr. Sloan in this second season premiere. What could be worse than an IRS tax audit?
Chip faces a life-or-death problem.
Robbie's blind date turns out badly.
Dennis thinks his dad is broke, so he sells bottles in an attempt to make some extra money.
Dennis starts a rumor that he and his family are moving to New York in order to keep Mr. Wilson in town for an award he is due to receive.
Dennis goes crazy trying to find his gifts.
Dennis meets Whip Crawford, his cowboy idol, after Mrs. Webster tells Dennis that Whip will be in the community pageant.
Betty becomes jealous when all the attention at school is directed at the new girl.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Great Guy
programmes.d: Bud hates his job, but feels that he can not quit because he has been bragging about it at home.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Family Goes To New York
programmes.st: The Family Goes To New York
programmes.d: Betty goes to New York to help out in her friends wedding.  While there, she ends up in the gossip column with her friend's new brother-in-law.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Betty Goes Steady
programmes.d: Betty tries to get in with the upper class kids at school while along the way losing sight of what really matters in life.

programmes.st: That Was the Dinner That Wasn't
programmes.d: Cissy's school is having a mother/daughter dinner. This makes Cissy miss her mother more.
Due to a miscommunication of who would watch Buffy and Jody, the twins find themselves all alone in New York City.

Giles French leaves town for a month, so his brother Niles comes to help with the Davis'. Jody is tired of always being around the girls and having to do the things they want to do. Uncle Bill decides to give him some masculine attention.

Jody and Buffy are excited to be moved to Upper First Grade at school, but it means more homework. They do not know how to do the math problems nor read some of the new books. Bill is spending more time dating than helping the twins.
Mike and the kids run the house while Carol is out of town.
Peter’s ego inflates after saving a girl from an accident.
Jan gets a locket from a secret admirer. As the family try to determine who anonymously sent the locket, they're momentarily distracted when Jan loses the locket.
Marcia falls for a boy who is more interested in bugs than girls.
Greg wants to quit school to become a major league pitcher.
Greg and Marcia baby-sit their siblings for an evening.

Mike and Lionel are planning on attending a demonstration at the United Nations. However, the rally gets out of hand and news of it appears on TV. This worries Gloria who begs Archie to go down there and get Mike.

A local election has the Bunker family in turmoil as Mike and Gloria are all for Claire Packer, a woman, which is why Archie is dead set against her. However, once down at the voting booths, Archie realizes that he can't vote because he isn't registered.

At the grocery store, Edith has an accident in the parking lot. She loses control of her shopping cart which smashes into a car and a can of Cling Peaches (in heavy syrup) flies out of the cart, onto the car, and makes a dent.

Mike is all stressed out with upcoming exams leaving him impotent and frustrated. Gloria encourages him to discuss it with her, but he refuses. Gloria confides in Edith what the problem is, and in turn she tells Archie.

The Bunkers are having problems with their furnace which gets Archie entertaining the idea of moving. When an unscrupulous black real-estate salesman, Mr. Byrd, offers Archie a hefty sum of money for his home, Archie is all for it despite Mike's warnings.

Archie comes home from work in a particularly awful mood because he has to make an important decision at work. His decision to lay off a Puerto Rican leads to an interesting visit to the Bunker household.

It's Christmas Day and Archie is the only one not in the Christmas spirit. Mike and Gloria question him, but he refuses to reveal what's bugging him. The Jeffersons come over to wish the Bunkers a 'Merry Christmas'.

Archie comes home from work in a great mood and orders Edith to have dinner ready and waiting, because he has to watch the CBS Evening News to see himself on it. Archie was interviewed as a man-on-the-street voicing his opinions on Nixon's presidency.
When Mama's dreams start providing the names of winning horses, the family figures they're in the money.
Mama, Iola and Naomi decide to have a chili cook-off with the winner getting her recipe in the church bazaar cookbook. Vint is choosen, against his will, as the judge of the contest.

When Vint and Naomi are having trouble in the bedroom, Mama and Iola soon discover exactly what it is when they turn on Good Morning Raytown, and special guest Dr. Joyce Brothers agrees to take a few phone calls live on-air.
Iola is distraught when her cat Midnight dies, although everyone else is thankful. But Iola refuses to let go and nothing can console her---until she decides to have it freeze-dried.

When Naomi gives Bubba and Vint a love test to see how romantic they are, it turns out Vint is a "cold fish" and Bubba is a "Red Hot Romeo." Vint decides to be more romantic and talks Bubba into writing her a love letter.

programmes.t: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programmes.d: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programmes.t: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programmes.d: Opening with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21; Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist.

Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz's "Symphonie," Op. 14; this performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.
Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.
Documentary exploring the development of music TV over the last 50 years and its power in popularizing the classical genre.

programmes.t: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programmes.d: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.
Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 5-8); recorded at St. Luke's, London.
A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.

Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto)...
Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

This is the story of the hunt for one of the most notorious serial killers in American history--the BTK killer. After committing at least seven brutal murders he vanished for over 25 years before sending clues of his crimes to the media in 2004.

programmes.st: Diary Of A Serial Arsonist/The Lost Clue
programmes.d: A highly-regarded California arson investigator is suspected of setting a series of fires, and in Texas, a man is convicted of raping and murdering his 68-year-old neighbor.

A murderer's saliva, found on envelopes, helps seal his doom 37 years after his first killing. And Colorado police crack a cold case 24 years later when they take a DNA sample from the victim's son that proves that his father murdered his mother.

A detective vows not to shave until he solves the murder of a young Oregon woman. It takes three years and a string of Mexican Mafia informants to crack the case and allow the dedicated detective to shave his beard.
A dry cleaning tag inside a sweatshirt left at a crime scene helps police track down a serial killer and rapist who had been eluding them for years.
In 1984, a 15-year-old girl is found murdered in her grandparents' home. For decades, a stalled investigation only fuels the town rumor mill, pointing an accusing finger at her 13-year-old sister.

We follow Det. Vince Velazquez of Atlanta and Capt. Russell Popham of East Point, Ga., as they work to solve the 1995 rape and murder of 14-year-old Nacole Smith, one of Atlanta's most notorious unsolved crimes.
One family faces two unsolved murders of their loved ones. It takes thirteen years for detectives to uncover the one missing clue that can lead them to the killer: the hidden crime scene.

In this special 100th edition of Cold Case Files, we look at the biggest serial murder case in U.S. history; hunt for the Green River Killer. Dave Reichert, the detective who made finding the killer his obsession, walks us through the case.
The body of Lori Nesson is found in a ditch in 1974, yet her death is not ruled a homicide. After four decades, the cause of death is changed to homicide, and the search begins for a killer.
Our cameras follow Detective Manny Reyes as he investigates the 1990 murder of a Fort Worth, Texas woman. Reyes talks to the woman's two sons, who believe that her husband, Bobby, was the murderer.

In late 1983, the bodies of five people abducted from a local fast food restaurant are found brutally murdered. The main suspect is long believed to be a well-connected local man, until new evidence reveals the true killers.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.
When 18-year-old Shannon Siders' body is found in the woods, everyone in the small town of Newaygo, Michigan, becomes a suspect--but no one is convicted of the crime.
The murder of an Ohio woman in 1974 is solved more than 20 years later after police get a crucial clue--the woman's husband was seen building a coffin-shaped box about the time the woman disappeared.
A Texas woman's murder is finally solved when the killer's plan to kill a second woman and stuff her into a duffel bag goes awry.
A bloody dagger and a phone tap help detectives solve a 20-year-old murder case. And DNA taken from an eyelash found on a dead prostitute's body brings a killer to justice.
Quinn and the Fashion Club look for ways to make a difference, and Daria feels self-conscious when she considers submitting a story to a publication.
A teachers' strike at Lawndale High results in Daria instructing Quinn's English class, and teachers turn to Trent and Jane for artistic advice.
To celebrate Abbi's 30th birthday, Abbi and Ilana travel from the top of Manhattan to the bottom, running into old and new friends along the way.
Ilana embarks upon her latest moneymaking opportunity when she opens an outdoor workspace for New York City smokers; Abbi stands up to her landlord after he refuses to update her plumbing.
Sarah's childish obsession with doodie humor jeopardizes her relationship with Laura.

programmes.st: The Sarah Silverman Program Joan of Arf
programmes.d: When Sarah gets caught tasting her dog's butt, the authorities take Doug away from her, sending her on an odyssey of self-doubt.
After a wild night of drinking with the boss's brother, things go bad at a DUI checkpoint.
Blake and Ders's world turns upside down when they lose Adam to a super-rich MILF.

programmes.st: In The Line Of Getting Fired
programmes.d: When the CEO of TelAmeriCorp arrives to liquidate the company, it's up to the guys to change his mind and save the day.
After a hard night of partying the guys try to go sober for a week.
When a hot girl temps at TelAmeriCorp, the guys have to find a way to not constantly have erections.
When something they love is taken from them, the guys go undercover at a high school to investigate.
The Obamas get intimate, the founding fathers talk gun control, and Metta World Peace makes a wish.
Homies learn how to go down on a lady, and MVP Ozamataz Buckshank rocks a post-game interview.
A hotel guest is blown away by the Continental breakfast, and a psycho's victims stay positive.
A guy learns how to buy drugs in public, and an executive tests a speech for political correctness.
Episode 8 includes Choke, Killing Time, Safe House, and Dude, A Reward, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 9 includes Walkathon, Temporary Insanity, Tainted Meat, Dream On, and Beaverly Buttbillies, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 2 includes Party, What's the Deal, Wet Behind the Rears, and Animation Sucks.

Episode 4 includes History of Women, Beavis Can You Spare A Dime?, Premature Evacuation, and Bang the Drum Slowly Dumbass.
Episode 5 includes Close Encounters, Vidiots, Tired, and Whiplash.
Nathan markets an unappealing children's toy, devises a way to shame people who share their movie snacks and pitches a reality show starring Simon the security guard.
Nathan tries to leverage Best Buy's price-matching policy by advertising a deal on TVs that's too good to be true.
Cramblin Duvet hits a hot streak, and Sam and Tim help Sheila find a lawyer after she gets a DUI.
Tension builds between Sam and Tim after Sam acts in one of their commercials, and Sheila's relationship with Lea becomes strained after she makes an off-color joke.
Iraqi police force cadets learn law enforcement skills from Reno's finest, and Dangle and Wiegel destroy a huge cocaine supply.
The Carson City Parade Float Contest brings out the deputies' competitive spirit.
Sergeant Clift, the LAPD's undercover acting coach, teaches the deputies the subtle art of theater.
Jackie, the pickle-throwing hooker, spends her twilight hours with the Reno Sheriff's Department.
When the citizens of South Park start exploding randomly, the mayor enlists Stan's dad, the resident geologist, to find a solution to the problem.
Chef's parents arrive in South Park from Scotland fresh from an encounter with the Loch Ness Monster to attend Chef's wedding.
The boys discover a prehistoric creature called a Jackovasaur while camping at Stark's Pond.

The BAU revisits its origins when they look at one of Rossi and Gideon's old cases to track a killer that got away.

When a 4-year-old girl goes missing while staying with a relative in Mississippi, the BAU uncovers some startling truths as the team races to find the child and bring her to safety. Series star Thomas Gibson directs the episode.
While the BAU looks for a vigilante killer on the loose in Cleveland, Rossi is concerned when his former Marine sergeant goes missing and heads to Los Angeles to find him.

When a passenger jet crashes in Colorado, the BAU team is called to build a profile around the suspicious circumstances. Also, the case hits close to home for Kate, who is reminded of a family tragedy.

The BAU believes two unsubs may be operating at the same time, when victims killed in two drastically different ways are discovered in the same city. Also, the team grapples with keeping Reid safe in prison. (TV-14 L, V)

Caught in an impossible scenario, Reid must square off with an old nemesis, and Derek Morgan (guest star Shemar Moore) comes to the team with a lead that might help catch Mr. Scratch, the elusive fugitive that has been tormenting the team all season.
As Hotch fights for his life due to complications from his stabbing at the hands of George Foyet, a.k.a. "The Reaper," he experiences visions of his late wife, Haley, and his nemesis, Foyet.
The BAU is called to Taos, N.M. to investigate an UnSub who is targeting his victims' temporal lobes.
When shooting victims are found in the Los Angeles area with possible links to criminal activity, the BAU searches for a vigilante UnSub.

When the BAU is called to Kansas City to investigate a series of murders, a tense reunion ensues between Blake and her father, a retired police captain, and her brother, a detective, who must work together to help solve the crime.
Rossi develops some new theories about Everett Lynch, aka The Chameleon.

When the BAU is called to Texas to consult on the murders of prostitutes, evidence points to killings with religious overtones. But as they delve further into the investigation, the team could put their lives at risk.
Agent Luke Alvez (Adam Rodriguez) joins the BAU team, which is tasked with capturing a killer who escaped prison with 13 other convicts at the end of last season.
The team searches for Everett Lynch and his daughter; Spencer visits with his mother.
The BAU heads to Austin to investigate victims found there with their watches set inaccurately, a clue which may connect the crimes.
Prentiss and The BAU team fly to Iowa to investigate the disappearance of three 10-year-old children who appear to have been abducted from their homes in the middle of the night.

The BAU team investigates a series of murders in Bakersfield, Calif., which have left the victims unidentifiable. Also, the team welcomes new agent Kate Callahan into the BAU fold, who assists them in their efforts in solving the cases.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Hundreds of hopefuls arrive at AT&T Stadium to start the rigorous audition process for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders, competing for the fewest number of open spots ever.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The 101 remaining hopefuls must master tough choreography, learn the famous DCC kick line and impress judges Melissa Rycroft and Charm La'Donna.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The candidates give panel interviews and solo performances before the rookies and veterans face off on the field and find out who makes it to training camp.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The pressure is on at training camp as both rookie and veteran candidates give it their all in front of their toughest audience yet.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli gives the ladies a tough kick line and jump-split workout, and choreographer Travis Wall teaches them a modern dance that will determine their future in the competition.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Charm La'Donna teaches the candidates a hip-hop-style routine, the judges pick their charm squad, the ladies visit the Dallas VA Medical Center and two rookies are sent home.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The candidates audition for the show group, an honorary contingent of 18 cheerleaders who represent the DCC on USO tours and TV, in front of guest judge Cheryl Burke.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Emmy-winner Tyce Diorio teaches the ladies to bring the magic as he puts them through a tough routine. Evan Miller challenges the DCC's power and musicality.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The recruits do media training with NBC 5 Dallas-Fort Worth lead news anchors Meredith Land, Kelli, and Judy name two triangle points, and guest judge Melissa Rycroft sits in.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team

Steve reluctantly goes on a dating game show and wins. Much to his pleasnat surprise, his date appears to be everything he's looking for and more.
Steve gets an unexpected phone call from Hawk, an old friend from the police force who has recently retired and moved into the Sunny Meadows rest home.
Marine Lt. Hank Thomas enters BBQ Bob's, the favorite lunchtime hangout of the doctors, wielding a gun in his left hand and threatening three other Marines who are already there.
Paraplegic, asthmatic game show contestant Sol Singer climbs into his specially-modified van and sets out to a TV studio where he is bout to compete on the live quiz show "Through the Roof."
Dear friend and famous pop singer Danielle Marsh comes from new York to stay with Mark and Steve while she prepares for a big comeback conecrt.

Roger and Lana's marriage is rocky at best. Lana plots for her lover to kill Roger while he is away for the night on business so that she can have all of his money.

While driving, David tells his wife Laura that he wants a divorce. Laura becomes hysterical and begins to cry and hit him. Trying to fight off his wife's attacks, David loses control of the car and flies into an intersection.

George, a schizophrenic homeless man, shows up on a beach prophesizing about death. The couple in the nearby beach apartment, Cynthia and Ethan, threaten to call the police.

When Steve Sloan is hospitalized for injuries sustained in a high-speed car chase, he wakes in a haze and watches with a blurred vision what looks like another patient being stabbed by one of the medical staff in his room.

Swiper is on Santa's naughty list! Dora believes Swiper can change and has to travel into the past and future to help him find 4 missing ornaments and learn the true meaning of Christmas.
Happy Birthday, Dora!  In the final episode of the Magic Storybook Trilogy (and a nod to The Wizard of Oz) Dora and Boots need to get home for Dora's birthday party.
Dora and Boots travel into a storybook to help their new friend Allie save the Crystal Kingdom. And they need your help! A greedy king has taken all of the crystals that make the kingdom colorful.
Dora, Boots, and the snowflake fairy are off to save La Princessa Sabrina and her snowy forest from a mean witch who's locked her in a tower and taken away her magic snow crystal.
Dora and Boots hop on Pegaso, the flying horse constellation, for a high-flying adventure to bring home his constellation friends to the moon before the sun rises.

Happy Birthday, Super Babies! It's the Twins' 1st birthday, and Dora reads them a very special Super Babies story. Once upon a time, there was a cake-snatching bear who stole all the cakes from the birthday boys and girls.
Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!

Dora and Boots find a lovable little space creature named Winky. He came to visit with his family, our Purple Planet friends. But, uh oh, he's lost. We have to get Baby Winky back to his family before their spaceship takes off!

programmes.st: The Grumpy Old Troll Gets Married
programmes.d: The Grumpy Old Troll's getting married to Petunia, and we all get to be a part of this wedding! Everything's almost ready, except the Grumpy Old Troll forgot to pick up the rings from his grandma's house! Will we make it in time for the wedding?!
Everyone's dressing up for the big Halloween parade! Dora and Boots are almost set to go, but their friend, Little Monster, doesn't have a costume.
Dora and Boots are going on vacation with Diego and Baby Jaguar at the Rainforest Campground. They're packing everything they need, especially Baby Jaguar's favorite, the Dora Snacks!

programmes.st: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Wand
programmes.d: The Big Red Chicken's doing magic tricks for us today! For his first trick, he turns Boots into a chicken! But when he's going to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that sends the wand flying off into Magic Land, where it breaks!

Dora and Boots are headed to a brand new playground just over the Troll Bridge.  When Dora and Boots get to the Bridge, they see that the Grumpy Old Troll's missing! Map tells us that the Troll is stuck in a magic Hole!
Dora's dance class is having a big show for all of their friends and family. Dora's starting the show, and she can't wait for her family to see her dance!
Dora and Boots are heading to the Bike Shop to pick up Boots' very first bike today.
Dora's helping her new friend, Pepe the Pig, learn all about his new school. Pepe's really excited, especially when he hears that if the class earns 3 gold stars today, they get a popcorn party!

programmes.st: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part I:  Tale of the Unicorn King
programmes.d: Unicornio has been chosen King of Enchanted Forest, but he needs help from Dora, Boots, and YOU to discover that he's kind, smart, brave and strong enough for the job!
Dora, Boots, and King Unicornio leave Enchanted Forest to join Diego in making the lost continent of Atlantis rise by ending an ancient feud between unicorns and dragons!

Dora and Boots are reading stories about knights when suddenly they hear a cry for help. It's a princess who's calling to us from the Royal Garden! It turns out that it's not the princess that needs saving—her kitty's stuck in a tree!

Swiper was packing all of his favorite things for a sleepover at his grandma's house. But just as he was about to go, a big wind came in and blew everything away! Will Swiper find a way to use his new super-Swiper-spin today?!

programmes.st: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Parts 2 and 3: Dora Saves King Unicornio
programmes.d: Dora and Boots return to the Enchanted Forest to save it from Owl, who has taken over as king and set up new rules banning scarecrows, elves, and fairies from the forest! But the Enchanted Forest is for everyone!
Dora and Boots are waiting for a visit from the Hip-Hop-Bunny, who's bringing all the Easter Eggs for the big Egg Hunt! But when Swiper swipes the hip-hop bunny's basket,
When the train to the Big Horse Show breaks down, Dora, Boots, and Pinto the Pony need your help to get there with the ribbons, so Pinto can win his first blue prize ribbon!
Dora and Boots are getting ready for a big beach picnic with their friends, but when Benny gets stranded on Coconut Island, he'll need rescuing from Dora, Boots and YOU!

Join Dora for a Father's Day adventure! When the Little Kite she makes for Papi gets blown away in the wind, she'll need your help taking a hovercraft and a go-cart to catch Little Kite before she goes out over the ocean!

Dora gets to start the Big Gymnastics Show! But when Swiper swipes her special rainbow ribbon, Dora and Boots need your help on a gymnastics-filled adventure to get it back so they can begin the show! Fantastic gymnastics!
One night, while taking care of Abuela's 3 kitties, Dora awakens to find that Lucky has chased a ball of string right into a storybook world! Help her find him on a magical moonlight adventure!

Dora has a big surprise for Perrito on Surprise Hill, but Swiper's trying to get there first to swipe it! Join Dora, Boots, and Perrito for an animal-filled adventure with help from lots of friends and their playful pets too!
Everyone's getting ready for the big Thanksgiving Day parade and dinner, but the Pirate Piggies accidentally float away on Dora's boat float.

Dora's on her way to the doctor's for her yearly check up!  Dora likes going to see Dr. Valds because she gets to hear her heartbeat, see how much she's grown in one year and get a new sticker at the end of the visit!

Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures, and today he's ready for his first treasure adventure! We help Little Map draw pictures and play map games to find the treasure at Treasure Mountain!
Dr. Mike must decide if a human birdman should be confined to a cage.

When Doc Eli, a medicine-show man, arrives in town professing to have created the perfect bottled elixir, Mike sets out to call his bluff, especially when her children's health becomes jeopardized.

Progress comes to Colorado Springs, and Sully pays the price.
When Cheyenne medicine man Cloud Dancing is wounded by General Custer, who intends to hang him, Sully and Dr. Mike join forces to help him escape.
