Krystle loses her baby; Steven and Sammy Jo begin dating, although Steven is in love with Claudia. Fallon continues her affair with Nick, and is jealous to find him visiting Krystle in the hospital.

Fallon learns she is pregnant and tells Jeff she is having an abortion; he agrees to divorce her but only if she bears the child. Krystle remains despondent over the loss of her baby; Claudia takes a job with Denver-Carrington.

Alexis tricks Blake into coming to Rome and further traps him by hiring a gossip photographer to snap suggestive photos of the two; Jeff begs Fallon to cancel her abortion; as Nick confronts Krystle, his consolation gives way to passion.

Nick tells Krystle of his deep feelings for her; Steven and Sammy Jo marry; Fallon cancels her abortion; after the scandal caused by the paparazzi photos of Alexis and Blake, Krystle leaves her husband.
Nick persuades Krystle to leave Blake; Steven and Sammy Jo announce they are married; Blake is attacked by gangsters and blinded when his car is bombed.
Blake remains blinded following the explosion; Nick asks Krystle to divorce her husband and marry him; Blake investigates Nick's past; Alexis is determined to drive Krystle from Denver.

Fallon confesses her love to Nick, but he is interested in Krystle; Blake's attempts to bring gangster Logan Rhinewood before a Crime Committee hearing are thwarted; Sammy Jo tells Alexis she knows her secret; Blake receives an anonymous letter.
Krystle says goodbye to Nick and leaves Denver; Blake offers to adopt Jeff; Cecil blackmails Claudia; Nick accepts Blake's explanation of his brother's death.

At a party in her honor, Sammy Jo embarrasses the Carringtons and reveals to Fallon that Blake is not her father; Jeff leaves the party with Claudia; Blake tells Krystle his eyesight is restored; Fallon is left unconscious after a car accident.

Fallon gives birth to a son; Alexis offers Sammy Jo $25,000 to leave Denver; Jeff and Claudia make love; Krystle accuses Alexis of killing her baby; Alexis learns Krystle and Blake are not legally married.

Upon learning he is not her true father, Fallon refuses to see Blake; Jeff falls in love with Claudia, who is caught stealing from Denver-Carrington; Fallon's baby undergoes emergency surgery; Claudia's husband and daughter are believed dead.

A blood test proves that Blake is Fallon's true father; Steven travels to Hollywood in search of his wife; Claudia learns her husband and daughter are believed to be dead; as Krystle struggles with an armed Claudia, the gun discharges.
A man who volunteered in South America fails to return home.
The team searches for a young woman who disappeared while on spring break.
A groom disappears a few weeks before his wedding.
Two ransom notes are delivered when a wealthy businessman is kidnapped.

Prohibited from performing at the BMT Awards, Sage reluctantly agrees to let Rigo perform in his slot; at the live awards performance, Rigo reveals a surprise for everyone that changes the direction of the entire tour.
Sage's actions during the night of the BMT Awards have landed him back in jail; Marquise's meddling upsets everyone; at the Tabernacle, Rigo thrills the audience, but haters confront him.
At Sage's evidentiary hearings, the D.A.'s strategy is working and Sage could be tried for murder; meanwhile, things heat up between Marquise and Angel.

Sage is freed from jail and ready to reclaim the tour as headliner; the Chicago show will be Rigo's final performance, and he's under pressure to come up with new material; Poppy and Colette butt heads over Rigo.

Romantic entanglements are tearing Sage, Colette, Rigo and Poppy in new directions; the love triangle between Davis, Odalie and Angel has come to a tipping point; Tal has a new position as Sage's creative director.

Things are increasingly hot and cold between Angel and Odalie as someone's keeping secrets; Collette hatches a plan to keep Rigo on the tour; Sage has an epiphany and pledges a new direction for his creative future.
As Chief Council, Mac juggles a lot of tasks for the Greenleaf clan; church complications, Grace and the appearance of his father send Mac on a course that could threaten his status.
Amidst public outcry, Grace reaches out to Officer Nelson; Noah evades Lady Mae's questions; Lady Mae encourages the Bishop to reveal a secret.
A debate over security at Calvary erupts following the church shooting; Mac's plans to leave the country life behind set off a chain of potential catastrophes.
Mac attempts to blackmail the Bishop but Grace intervenes; Sophia's father, Ray, expresses doubts about Grace's parenting; Charity speaks up.
Surrounded by scandal, the church is losing money and members; Ray tries to get custody of Sophia; Jacob's offers to help are rejected; Kevin gains closure.

Deacon Sykes discusses women's day with Lady Mae and wants Grace to preach; Mavis has problems with her club; Grace, Ray and Sophia attend a custody hearing; Charity and Kevin talk about his feelings.
Lady Mae wants to preach at women's day, but Deacon Sykes is not convinced; Basie wants Jacob to run a new community center that will be built near Calvary; Lady Mae confronts Mavis.
The Feds turn the heat up on Tommy and scare LaKeisha into cooperating; Ghost discontinues a relationship with an ally; Tasha confronts a snitch, which hits a little too close to home.

Donnie Yen stars as infamous real-life drug kingpin Crippled Ho, who ruthlessly carved out his empire in 1960's Hong Kong.
In the action-packed second chapter of the Iceman saga, Ying's heroic fight to rewrite history and reclaim his honor continues but those he trusts most may be leading into a deadly trap.
Set during the Korean War, a band of prisoners at a POW camp find distraction from the hardships of war and a new sense of freedom in dancing.

Shan (Donnie Yen) is a hardline cop with a long history of success, but his past comes back to haunt him when a sting is attacked by a group led by his former protégé (Nicholas Tse), a man set on destroying everyone who ever wronged him.

Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

When a young gambler runs afoul of the gang rigging a local betting ring, his luck soon runs out. When they show up to collect, he faces dire consequences, and his siblings must fight for their land and their lives—before time runs out.
After being slain by a group of criminals, a man is reborn with animal-like superpowers and makes it his mission to right the wrongs of his city.
In Shanghai, two escaped prisoners rise to power in the Green Gang under boss Mr. Tang. But betrayal threatens to upend their alliance and control over the city's underworld.

'The Inspector's Club': the Inspector accepts a challenge to solve the mystery of the mythical lost city of Atlantis. 'A Royal Pain': Bellhop Pinky stands in for a visiting 10-year-old king at a King's Convention and nearly starts World War III.

programmes.st: Black & White & Pink All Over/Beach Blanket Pinky
programmes.d: 'Black & White & Pink All Over:' Detective Pinky agrees to locate a pesky little girl's doll. 'Beach Blanket Pinky': The Panther must rally the regulars at his favorite beach to defeat the Dogfather and company who have marked the beach as theirs.

'Digging For Dollars': The Inspector falls for a beautiful bank robber who uses a tunnel beneath his house to pull off her latest heist. 'Pinkocchio'' Lonely woodcarver Pink creates a little wooden boy whom he must then rescue from the Dogfather.

programmes.st: Pinky Up The River/Long John Pinky
programmes.d: 'Pinky Up The River': The Panther opens a river rafting operation only to encounter competition from Manly Man. 'Long John Pinky': The Panther gets shanghaied into being the cook aboard a pirate ship and must outsmart the dreaded Captain R. Gyle.

Scott's werewolf family comes to town for a family reunion. Scott's cousin, Eva, goes on a date with Mick, and it's Scott's responsibility to protect the family secret before it's revealed that Eva is a werewolf.
Pam's sheepdog, Daisy, gets loose and chases Ballard the cat.  When Mr. Conroy is called to catch Daisy, he bumps into Grandpa, switches glasses with him, and takes him to the pound instead of Daisy.

His landlady smells a fish when Mr. Bean gets a bird. Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper.

Sunbathing proves a more strenuous pursuit for Mr. Bean. It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather.

Mr. Bean forgets his teddy’s Birthday - then gives him a treat to remember. Mr. Bean is shocked when Teddy receives a birthday card from Bean’s girlfriend, Irma Gobb. The bear’s Birthday had completely slipped his mind.
Mr. Bean loses control of a pest and makes a mountain out of a molehill. Mr. Bean’s landlady is hopping mad on finding molehills on her lovely croquet lawn.
Uncle Quigley decides to reinstate Family Fun Night on Saturdays evenings! Sabrina and the Aunts think that Quigley is in serious need of a love life.
Sabrina is excited to visit Uncle Quigley in his lab while taking a field trip to the observatory.
Gem’s family has suddenly gone bankrupt and she is forced to stay with Sabrina.
It’s time for Sabrina’s wisdom teeth to come out. She doesn’t want to experience it the mortal way so she opts to have them removed magically.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: To Have and to Hold Back
programmes.st: To Have and to Hold Back
programmes.d: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mermaid Magic
programmes.d: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Power Play
programmes.d: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the café. Cleo's caught in the crossfire with Kim when Samantha moves in and puts her stamp on the Sertori home.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Dark Side
programmes.d: Rikki's frustrated by the water attacks and goes to Mako Island on a full moon to confront the strange force in the Moon Pool. With Cleo and Bella delayed, Will pursues her and discovers she's been affected by the experience.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Magnetic Attraction
programmes.d: Cleo's introduced to Ryan, a young geophysicist who's working for Samantha. Rikki doesn't react well to Cleo consulting Ryan about the Mako rock and a fracture begins to appear in the trio.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Into the Light
programmes.d: Rikki fears Ryan's explorations on Mako Island will uncover their secrets but Cleo and Bella discount her concern. She almost goes too far trying to stop Ryan from discovering the crystals in the Moon Pool.
During a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Gus' powers mysteriously begin to fail while fending off Zarlak's forces. Investigation reveals that the magic-loss is affecting Gus' whole Elfin family.

Kasimir is stunned when she loses a Scootsoomer race to Lucrezia. Gus thinks Kazz is obsessed with winning and refuses to listen when Kazz says she thinks Lucrezia cheated. Kazz discovers a Leprechaun was forced to help her cheat and Zarlak.
The Enchanted School gets more than they expected when their new Librarian arrives. Aside from his immense knowledge of books, Professor Begelboyce brings tales of fantastic exploits.

Cassy is doing a report for Wish Giving Class when a powerful force from center-earth steals all her visual aides. We learn right away that it's Zarlak. He has coerced the legendary Ring of The Blue Moon.
Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. He works out she’s still a mermaid and tries to win her back. Cleo becomes suspicious of Lewis spending time with Charlotte.
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.

Cleo is worried when she sees her dad around with another woman. When she arrives at their house, she turns out to be Charlotte's mother. Meanwhile, Rikki and Emma attempt to save the Sertori's dinner with their powers.
Everyone is shocked when Cleo is fired at the Ice Cream Stand, and even more so when Lewis takes her place! Rikki and Emma strike back at him but end up going too far.
Zane has an argument with a man in a trailer park but little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.
Marshall and a friend each want to win the heart of the same girl, who has a heart condition that brings her to Eerie hoping to have a transplant.
Marshall worries about his friend who becomes obsessed with heavy metal music to cope with a father who continually berates him.
Self-centered and conceited Prince Charming has only two goals in life: to look maahvelous, daaahling, and to reach the castle of Sleeping Beauty in order to kiss her out of her spell.
Craig and William are just about the only two people left who care about Rottmuckers Wax Museum and its collection of classic monsters.
Young Peters birthday is coming up, and he's looking forward to spending the weekend with his overworked father, a scientist at the local museum.

Wendell the nerd never wanted any trouble.  In fact, he did everything he could to fit in and earn the respect of tough jock Rex Reavis and his friends, including dismissing all their cruel practical jokes with a shrug and a laugh.
While filling in for Frasier, Niles gains fame after counseling a local basketball star who's in a slump.
After Daphne gets dumped by her boyfriend, Niles decides it's time to declare his love for her.
Frasier and Lilith join forces so that their son can gain admission to the most prestigious private school in Boston.

programmes.st: Our Father Whose Art Ain't Heaven
programmes.d: Martin buys Frasier an expensive painting -- but Frasier doesn't have the heart to tell his father that he hates it.

programmes.st: Dad Loves Sherry the Boys Just Whine
programmes.d: Frasier and Niles disapprove of Martin's relationship with his brassy new girlfriend.
Frasier finds himself in a precarious position when he tries to help the troubled marriage of a former high school acquaintance.
When Frasier becomes fed up with the rules and regulations governing his condominium complex, he decides to run for condo board president.
When Eddie shows signs of depression, a pet therapist thinks Martin's dog is simply reacting to the dysfunctional Crane family!
When the Crane brothers go away for the weekend with two attractive women, Niles discovers he hasn't quite cut his emotional ties to Maris.
Niles moves into a prestigious building and tries to impress his snobby neighbors with an elegant dinner party.

programmes.st: Roz's Krantz and Gouldenstein Are Dead
programmes.d: While volunteering at a retirement home, Roz becomes convinced that she's "the angel of death" after her first two patients die on her.
Rather than show his son that his dad's not perfect, Frasier agrees to join the station's softball team -- even though he has no idea how to play the game.
When an on-air hosting spot opens up at the station, Roz decides to go for it -- but Frasier's agent has other ideas.
Frasier's attempts to produce a live, 1940s-style radio drama for the station's fiftieth anniversary produce chaos instead.
While Frasier tries to juggle three dates in three days, Martin and his girlfriend face the prospect of breaking up.
Frasier tries to get Martin and Sherry to reconcile -- to the detriment of his own love life.
Frasier and Niles are caught in the middle when Martin's girlfriend and Daphne can't stop bickering.
Frasier tries to console Niles after Maris serves him with divorce papers.
When Niles asks Frasier whether he and Maris belong together, Frasier goes out of his way to give his brother an honest, thoughtful response.
Frasier comes down with a case of the "bachelor blues" when he realizes that every single person he knows is dating someone -- except him.
Nobody believes Frasier when he claims to be dating a famous supermodel.
The sibling rivalry between Frasier and Niles reaches a fever pitch when they try and "top" each other's 65th birthday gift to their father, Martin.
Niles' Halloween costume party becomes a comedy of errors when he mistakenly thinks that Daphne is pregnant -- and Frasier's the father.
Frasier is stunned when he learns the true identity of the man who is the father of Roz's baby.
Niles' envy and a series of mishaps may prevent Frasier from attending the festivities honoring him for his 1,000th radio show.
To take Niles' mind off his marital problems, Frasier invites him on an Alaskan cruise -- but neglects to tell Niles he's also invited Maris as a "surprise."
Frasier falls for a high-powered lawyer, whose successful career and take-charge attitude turns Frasier into a "wimp."
When, Frasier gets "dumped" by his high-powered girlfriend Sam, he makes a fool of himself trying to win her back.
It's a Christmas to remember when Martin sings in a church pageant, Niles gets stuck in an elevator, and Frasier spills the beans about Roz's pregnancy to her unsuspecting mother.

programmes.st: Where Every Bloke Knows Your Name
programmes.d: Daphne's attempts to lift Frasier's spirits by taking him to her favorite British pub backfires when Frasier decides to become a regular at "her" hangout.

programmes.st: Ain't Nobody's Business If I Do
programmes.d: The discovery of an engagement ring hidden in their father's drawer leads Niles and Frasier to investigate Sherry's checkered past before Martin has a chance to "pop the question."
Fed up with his cutthroat agent Bebe, Frasier soon learns the high price of hiring a "nice" agent to represent him in contract negotiations.
Niles is shocked to discover that his trusted marriage counselor and Maris are having a torrid affair behind his back.
Three-time male model of the year, Derek Zoolander, is devastated when he loses the title to newbie Hansel. After the news, Mugatu's fashion empire brainwashes Derek into being an assassin.

When the world's most beautiful people face danger, former models Derek and Hansel step in to tackle a top-secret mission against the criminal mastermind Mugatu. Get ready for a dangerously sexy adventure where looks truly can kill.

programmes.st: Brother, Can You Spare A Crime?
programmes.d: A man shows up claiming to be Hammer's brother. Everyone's taken with him including Doreau who goes out with him. But while on their date she catches him in a lie proving that he isn't Hammer's brother.
Bad news for the city's scum suckers: a blow to the head results in Dori Doreau adopting the ultra-violent personality and mannerisms of her partner, Sledge Hammer.
Alex decides to become the backup goalie for BMS' hockey team is the perfect way to avoid his conditioning obligations and Radon quickly follows suit.

Ricky, Fred, and Ethel don't believe that Lucy could go one day without telling a lie. To prove their point, they bet her $100 that within 24 hours she'll be fibbing up a storm.

The Ricardos and Mertzes have a close encounter of the French kind when they go to a bistro and have no clue how to read the menu. Later on, Lucy and Ethel decide to brush up on their French in order to get into the show.
Ethel complains about how shabby her apartment is. She's ashamed of holding a meeting for the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League at her place where women will be donning minks.

It all started with the good intention of getting Fred a new suit for his birthday. Lucy needed to "borrow" an old suit of Fred's for the correct measurements, but there was a witness to her burglary.

Lucy and Ethel are sick of their husbands dressing like slobs when they go out together in the evenings. After one particular outing, the girls get fed up and give their old clothes to a second-hand store.

Lucy gets another shot at being a star when a talent scout for the movies comes to town. Casting for the production agrees to audition Lucy after she gives him an impromptu performance of "There's No Business Like Show Business" with the Mertzes.

A magazine test has gotten Lucy into a tizzy. Lucy and Ricky take a test called "How to Rate Your Marriage." One of the questions in the quiz asks about old flames. When Lucy rattles off a list of old boyfriends, Ricky feels the need to compare.
Out of money, and in need of a million dollar idea, Lucy goes into the business of selling salad dressing. Marketing her salad dressing on TV, Lucy elicits Ethel's help with the advertisement.
Lucy plays the dominant parent role in their son's life. Realizing that he needs to spend more time with his son, Ricky agrees to spend his vacation at home to care for little Ricky.

The Ricardos are hosting an evening with friends. When the last guest to arrive introduces his date—all the men at the party fawn over her. Disgusted by the men's behavior, Lucy and Ethel begin to doubt their own feminine wiles.
Lucy and Ricky's thirteenth anniversary is rapidly approaching. In an outward show of affection, they buy each other gifts—golf clubs for Ricky and fur for Lucy.

The Ricardos are being interviewed for a "day-in-the-life" magazine article on happy married couples. The interviewer arrives at 7 AM just in time to encounter Lucy making breakfast in a frilly lace apron, while Ricky walks in wearing a smoking jacket.

The Mertzes get a pair of new tenants. Sam and Nancy Johnson are from Texas and reportedly have inside knowledge of a certain oil stock that is about to shoot through the roof. Lucy and Ethel are excited by the prospect, but Fred and Ricky have doubts.

How long can Ricky Ricardo go, without losing his temper? When Lucy buys a new hat for $49.50, Ricky goes ballistic. To make a point, Lucy bets Ricky the cost of the hat that he'll lose his temper long before her next purchase.

Hurt that no one seems to care for his home movies, Ricky declares that he will never show them another feature of his...not even the TV pilot he's creating. Jealous of his project, Lucy enables the help of the Mertzes and creates her own musical western.

Ricky scoffs at his wife and Ethel when they adamantly participate in the hunt for the "Bonus Buck" that will win them prize money from a newspaper contest. Later,  Ricky discovers one of the lucky bucks in his own wallet.

Lucy desperately wants to accompany her husband on his concert tour of Hawaii, but Ricky can't afford to bring her along. Unsatisfied, Lucy decides she'll win a trip for herself and neighbors, The Mertzes, by entering a television game show contest.

In an attempt to compete with her wealthy friends, Lucy pledges $500 (that she doesn't have) to charity. Luckily, Ethel spots an ad in Billboard magazine willing to pay $500 to anyone willing to perform a stunt to publicize a new movie, Women From Mars.

Lucy wants to be a published author after hearing about another housewife who made a fortune doing it. Ricky and the Mertzes don't like it when they discover Lucy's book plays too close a resemblance to real life including anecdotes from their own lives.

Lucy organizes an orchestra among her girlfriends, but it plays so horribly that she asks her bandleader husband, Ricky, to come to a rehearsal and give them some advice. His direction does little to help.

Lucy decides to try a new look, despite her husband Ricky's objections. She borrows a black wig from her hairdresser Roberta, who tells Lucy it makes her look like a whole different person. With that in mind, Lucy decides to play a little trick on Ricky.

Ricky becomes interested in a diner that is for sale so the Ricardos and the Mertzes all buy it together. Right away, Ethel and Fred feel they are doing all the work while Lucy and Ricky have all the fun.
Lucy's mother writes to ask if she and her husband "Xavier" would be so kind as to entertain "a friend's roommate's cousin's middle boy, Ernest" when he visits New York.

Lucy and Ricky, tired of the extensive visit by their cousin Tennessee Ernie, try to get rid of the likeable character by pleading poverty. Ernie then tries to help his gracious hosts out of their fiscal desperation.

Golf pro, Jimmy Demaret, visits Lucy and Ethel on the green to show them how the game is really played after they're misled by Ricky and Fred. Lucy and Ethel decide they'll learn how to play golf to spend more time with their husbands.

Ricky books a two-month summer job in Maine and decides to take Lucy and Little Ricky. For the summer, they want to sublet their apartment at a profit, but their friends and landlords, the Mertzes, are not in favor.

Ricky Ricardo hires business manager Mr. Hickox to solve the family budget problems. Lucy, dissatisfied with her new $5 per month allowance, manages to find a loophole in the business manager's system.

Lucy agrees to help her neighbor Fred Mertz impress an old vaudeville buddy who's in town for a visit. Lucy poses as the Mertzes maid "Bessie" to make Barney Kurtz believe Fred hit it big in real estate.
Lucy feigns a crisis to test Ricky's love after hearing a story about a woman whose husband ignored her pleas for help while being robbed—she assumes Ricky would turn his back on her too.
Lucy plays Cupid and tries to bag a bachelor for a husband-hungry girlfriend. Lucy organizes an evening to show her unmarried friends, Dorothy and Sam, how wonderful marriage is.

Ricky agrees reluctantly to host a new television show, sponsored by Phipps Department Store, and learns they'd like him to host with his wife Lucy. When Lucy finds out that Ricky didn't want her in the show, she sets out to sabotage the program.
When Ben Benjamin arrives at the Ricardos' apartment, Lucy mistakes Ben Benjamin, a Hollywood talent scout, for a burglar and nearly ruins Ricky's chance for a film career.
Lucy sees Ricky's screen test as an opportunity to get discovered as a new movie star.
America's vote brings two eliminated artists back for a live tattoo face-off, and after a final 35-hour tattoo, the judges award one artist with the title of Ink Master.
A new batch of artists face off in a convention-style challenge to earn their spot in the competition, and the judges assign canvases to the artists in the elimination tattoo.
Live scorpions and tarantulas are muses in a Flash Challenge, one artist eyes the exit, and tattoo artist Tommy Montoya is a guest judge.
A trip to Coney Island tests the artists' consistency in a team-based Flash Challenge on a pair of twin canvases, and artist Carlos Torres joins the panel as a guest judge.
Canvases bare all in a revealing Flash Challenge, and New York Yankees pitcher CC Sabathia judges artists' tattoo placements in the Elimination Challenge.
The artists design tattoos for X-Men superfans in the Flash Challenge, canvases sit for a color portrait Elimination Tattoo, and actor Hugh Jackman is a guest judge.
The artists test their adaptability in the Flash Challenge, brokenhearted canvases seek coverup tattoos, and guest judge Freddy Corbin helps to eliminate two more artists.
An artist has a tense altercation with a judge, gunpowder is used to create designs in the Flash Challenge, and guest Rob Zombie assesses horror-themed Elimination Tattoos.
Boxing champion Brandon Rios tasks the artists with designing him custom mouth grills, tensions flare between an artist and a canvas, and an artist is accused of plagiarism.
Relationships between the artists are tested with a collaborative Elimination Challenge, and traditional tattoo expert Luke Wessman helps the judges send one more artist home.
Canvases sit for a Statue of Liberty tattoo in the Flash Challenge, the artists design snake-themed Elimination Tattoos, and tattoo expert Taki is a guest judge.
The artists design tattoos for breast cancer survivors, and the artists are tasked with a convention-style coverup challenge.
The artists and judges reflect on their experiences during the season, Kyle Dunbar confronts Chris Nunez, and America's votes are tallied to crown a new Ink Master.
Competing for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master, 18 rival artists are forced to ink with their enemy.
Actor Joe Manganiello joins as a guest judge in a semi-nude Flash Challenge, and rivalries flare as the artists struggle through a pinup Elimination Tattoo.
Two artists receive an advantage no one in the competition has ever had, and the artists create complex ornamental-style Elimination Tattoos.

programmes.st: Inuyasha Shows His Tears For The First Time
programmes.d: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have stopped breathing. Inuyasha searches for the Band of Seven to avenge them.

programmes.st: The Secret of the Pure Light
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang approach the light of a Sacred Jewel which appears to belong to the Band of Seven, but the light is not corrupt.

programmes.st: Hidden in the Mist: Onward to Mt. Hakurei!
programmes.d: Suikotsu's Band of Seven personality awakens and fights Inuyasha. When the children call out to him to turn back, he holds his head in pain.

programmes.st: Enter Bankotsu, The Leader of the Band of Seven
programmes.d: There is a barrier around Mt. Hakurei that purifies demons or anything evil.

programmes.st: The Big Clash: Banryu versus the Wind Scar
programmes.d: The battle between Bankotsu and Inuyasha begins. Meanwhile, Sesshomatu comes to Mt. Hakurei.

programmes.st: Afloat on the Lake Surface: the Barrier of Hijiri Island
programmes.d: There is a holy island in a lake surrounded by mist. Saint Hakushin, who become a living Buddha a hundred years ago, is venerated there.

programmes.st: The Sacred Vajra and the Mystery of the Living Buddha
programmes.d: Bankotsu gets Kagome and the others involved in his battle with Inuyasha. Inuyasha is angered that his friends are getting hurt, and corners Bankotsu.
Mt. Hakurei's holy barrier prevents demons from entering it. Saint Hakushin helped Naraku, and placed the barrier.
Mt. Hakurei gets stronger, and Kikyo is prevented from going into its hold ground.
Suikotsu cannot kill Chiyo and the others. Jakotsu stops him. He senses an attack from Sesshomaru.

programmes.st: Vanished in a River of Flames
programmes.d: Ginkotsu has died, and Renkotsu uses his shard without permission. In doing so, he has betrayed Bankotsu. He cannot go back anymore.

programmes.st: Into the Depths of Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: The evil within Mt. Hakurei is Naraku's demons and Kagura. Miroku risks his life to save Sango, by opening his Wind Tunnel and sucking in the demons.
Miroku and Sango come face to face with the Saint Hakushin's mummy on Mt. Hakurei. The saint tells them his reason for helping Naraku.
Inuyasha regains his demon powers. He defeats Jakotsu, and hurries to Mt. Hakurei. Renkotsu has rebellious feelings towards Bankotsu.

programmes.st: Final Battle: The Last and Strongest of the Band of Seven
programmes.d: Mt. Hakurei's barrier disappears. Inuyasha is worried about Kagome. Kagome heads to Mt. Hakurei with Koga and the others.

programmes.st: The Power of Banryu: Duel to the Death on Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: Miroku and Sango see a mysterious lump of flesh in the depths of Mt. Hakurei.
Naraku has gained a new body and has been reborn.
Mt. Hakurei is destroyed. Koga falls to the bottom of it. Inuyasha saves him.
Inuyasha is pulled away from his friends when he is tricked by fake information that Kikyo is still alive.
Naraku's baby carries Kagome to an abandoned temple. He orders Kagura to place a corrupt Sacred Jewel shard in her.

programmes.st: Don't Boil It! The Terrifying Dried-Up Demon!
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, Naraku has sent a demon called Mimisenri to look for the Sacred Jewel shards.

programmes.st: Battle Against the Dried-Up Demons at the Cultural Festival!
programmes.d: On the day of the cultural festival, the dried demons that Kagome brought from feudal Japan are revived. They devour the food that Yuka and the others made.
A demon named Chokyukai is revived, and begins to steal girls. A young man named Kisuke comes to Kaede for help. Inuyasha go to defeat the demon.

programmes.st: Shippo's New Technique, The Heart Scar!
programmes.d: Five demon fox brothers believe Shippo to be a hero. They become his disciples to learn his special technique, the Wind Scar.

programmes.st: Trap of The Cursed Wall Hanging
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Shinosuke, who is looking for his fiancée. They are led to a village of only women, and are separated by sex into their rooms.
At a village where only women live, a demon that was sealed away in a hanging scroll at Kanondo is revived.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 1
programmes.d: Sara, a mysterious woman, appears before Sara. Sara was once saved by Sesshomaru. She was reincarnated just as she had died from an illness.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 2
programmes.d: Sara asks Sesshomaru to destroy her along with the spirit. Sesshomaru complies, and uses the Tessaiga to destroy Sara along with the spirit.

programmes.st: The Last Banquet of Miroku's Master
programmes.d: Priest Mushin, the person who raised Miroku, is going to die. Miroku and the others are shocked.
A treasure stealing invisible demon appears. An old lady who failed to defeat him asks Inuyasha and the gang for help.
Akitoki, Hoji's ancestor is on a journey to offer the Hojo family heirloom, the Kenkon Naginata, a demon sword that brings disaster.

programmes.st: Mountain of Demons: Survival of the Duo
programmes.d: Akitoki and Inuyasha travel the shrine of the wind and thunder gods to make an offering to seal away the blade's demon powers.

programmes.st: The Great Duel at Shoun Falls!
programmes.d: Hoshiyomi uses the Kon blade to steal the Tessaiga's demon powers.

Jane gets a big break in her career, but it all seems too good to be true, especially when it involves Rogelio.  Rafael is stressed about Sin Rostro's connection to the hotel and begins to fear for his family's safety.

Jane and Rafael are excited to find out the sex of the baby, but a medical issue means Jane might miss her graduation.  Xo notices that something is going on with her mother, Alba, but Alba is too embarrassed to talk about it.
Michael is convinced that Rafael is helping to hide his father and puts the thought into Jane's head as well, making her grow suspicious of Rafael's recent actions.
When Jane and Rafael receive news about their baby's health, they revisit moving in together which prompts a surprise from Rafael.

Jane is feeling distant from Rafael so she focuses on her writing instead, but is stuck with a case of writers block. When Jane runs into Michael he mentions a romance writing workshop, and she thinks she has found the solution.

When a crisis with the hotel overwhelms Rafael, Jane becomes concerned that he might not be as hands-on in fatherhood as she expected. Alba is having a difficult time with Xo's living situation which causes a strain between them.
Jane unintentionally ruins Rafael's chances of getting the hotel's liquor license back, but her attempt to help fix it means missing the Villanueva's Easter festivities.

Jane is desperate to fix things with Rafael and suggests working on a way to help them move past their problems.  Xo has been keeping a secret from Rogelio, but when she finally comes clean to him, Rogelio's reaction surprises her.

Jane is determined to do what's best for the baby, especially after she and Rafael learn that the baby is breech.  Xo (Andrea Navedo) continues to try to apologize to Rogelio, but faces an uphill battle.

Jane is nervous to attend her five year high school reunion because she feels her life is not what she expected it to be. Rafael confides in Petra about Jane's custody request, making Petra think she can fix the problem and become the hero.
After having false labor, Jane insists that Xo  and Rogelio go to Las Vegas to perform their show, but once they are gone the labor turns very real.
After Jane discovers Mateo's abduction, chaos ensues, especially when they all learn Sin Rostro is involved and demanding a ransom.
Jane is in a rhythm with Mateo, but finds herself out of step with Rafael and Michael and the potential love triangle brewing between them.
When a slot opens up in the graduate program that Jane has been waiting for, she is faced with her first big motherhood dilemma - leaving Mateo sooner than expected.
As Jane tries to juggle motherhood and school, she forgets to plan Lina's (guest star Diana Guerrero) surprise 25th birthday party leading to friction between the best friends.
Jane thinks she's ready to make a decision about her love life.  Alba has taken the proper steps to become a citizen, but Xo's past might make it more difficult than anyone was expecting.
Jane and Rafael begin estate planning for Mateo, but when Jane realizes that Mateo will inherit millions, she worries he will become spoiled. Jane is also finally starting graduate school.

Rachel is suing her landlord because she claims he forced her to lose her job.
Jill is suing Laura after failing to repay a loan, but Laura says it was a gift.
When Paul's expensive remote control helicopter "disappears" from Sean's consignment shop, Paul claims foul play.

An animated film about a barnyard rooster (the voice of Glen Campbell) who goes to Las Vegas and finds success as an Elvis-impersonating nightclub singer.

A wonderful, song-filled feature about an unlovable, murdered mutt (Burt Reynolds) who returns to Earth to do a good deed. He adopts an orphan girl who can communicate with animals and helps lead him to his killer.

Charlie and Itchy are back! Those lovable mutts from the treasured Family hit "All Dogs Go To Heaven" return for an all-new Animated Musical Adventure. Features the voices of Charlie Sheen, Dom DeLuise and Sheena Easton.
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.

programmes.t: Norm of the North: King Sized Adventure
programmes.d: An ancient Chinese artifact has been stolen by a villainous archaeologist named Dexter. With the help of his lemming friends, Norm must keep his word and embark on a journey across the world to help recover the artifact for the people of China.
When a take-charge alpha wolf and a laidback omega wolf get relocated halfway across the country, the two must set off on an incredible journey home in this CGI-animated adventure.
Fun, drama, and suspense come vividly to life in this enchanting fantasy cartoon, based on Robert O'Brien's award-winning tale of a timid mouse who becomes a heroine in spite of herself.

programmes.t: The Secret of N.I.M.H. 2: Timmy to the Rescue
programmes.d: The rats and mice, made intellectually superior in the original Secret of N.I.M.H., return to THorrorn Valley to groom their destined leader - young Timmy Brisby.

programmes.t: The Adventures of Peanut and Pig
programmes.d: The floating paradise of Goola is in big trouble when the island begins to sink! An unlikely team of rival monkeys, a scientist bunny, and a jolly pig will put aside their differences and learn about friendship and bravery to save the day.
When Henry Bigg's parents are lost in Africa, the boy must go live with his mean Uncle Augustus.

programmes.t: Norm of the North: King Sized Adventure
programmes.d: An ancient Chinese artifact has been stolen by a villainous archaeologist named Dexter. With the help of his lemming friends, Norm must keep his word and embark on a journey across the world to help recover the artifact for the people of China.
The dream chasers go after their missing memories and the dream chasers try find the Never Witch's hide-out while Phil covers for them at Castle Nocturnia.

The dream chasers feel like they should be taking the fight to the Never Witch instead of training for R.E.M. trials. Zoey's haunted by her most painful memories and Mateo continues to only dream craft Z-Blob-related items.
Set in the past, the dream chaser duo Hannah and Beau argue while young Oz searches for Lunia.

In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle.  The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here.  The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.”

Jestro, while still attacking the King’s Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he’s found (and has been saving.)  It’s the powerful “Book of Revenge!”
As the Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they’re always getting over on him.
Jestro’s not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands.  “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure,” says the Book of Monsters so they’ve got to go out looting!
Prince Kalmaar deceives the Merlopians and turns the ninja into fugitives.
Aided by Benthomaar, the ninja fight their way through the palace to the Hydro Bounty and must escape Kalmaar's forces.
The tragic tale of Benthomaar is revealed, a tale filled with treachery, betrayal, but also with a glimmer of hope.
Nya and the ninja race to obtain the Storm Amulet before Prince Kalmaar can get it and use it to awaken the doomsday serpent, Wojira.
In NINJAGO City, Wu, Cole, Kai, Ray, and Misako must infiltrate the Explorer's Club and recover the Storm Amulet before King Kalmaar and his troops.
Prince Kalmaar attacks NINJAGO City to obtain the Storm Amulet, but he runs into an unexpected obstacle: a determined young papergirl.

Devoted mother of two, Heather Strong, disappears, leaving her two children with her estranged husband, Josh; as Josh becomes an obvious suspect, an unlikely and sinister offender emerges.
A community bands together to search for a missing woman; police are unable to solve the case until they speak to her husband's close friend and learn some startling information.

Kathy Lujan, a married mother of two young boys, is believed to have run away with her lover. Detective Rosie Rodriguez chases a trail of evidence and suspects that reveal the truth about Kathy's whereabouts.

A woman discovers the body of her nephew and investigators must unravel the events that led to his demise, but with three viable suspects, it takes about a year to crack the case using the smallest piece of DNA evidence from the crime scene.
After authorities finally identify the prolific Green River Killer, it becomes a cat-and-mouse game as they must get inside his mind to get him to lead them to the remains of other missing women.

A year after a popular high school senior goes missing, a witness comes forward claiming to know who is responsible for her disappearance and detectives must unravel a web of lies in order to learn the truth.
After a hardworking Virginia couple is brutally murdered on the eve of their anniversary, the ensuing investigation goes cold until detectives find the most unlikely of suspects.
When a woman is found dead in her home, police aren't sure if it's an accident or a murder until they get an unexpected call, from an unexpected person.

After the naked body of an Ohio State senior is found, investigators bring in a suspect for questioning; they play a dangerous game of give and take hoping to get the truth and bring justice to the victim and her family.

Investigators speak for the first time on one of the most baffling cases they've encountered, exposing the truth about what happened to Shanann Watts and her two daughters at the hands of a seemingly devoted husband and father, Chris Watts.
After getting a call that a wife and mother had been missing for 10 years, sheriffs launch an investigation that uncovers a web of lies that leads them to the truth.
A crazed driver goes on a seven-hour shooting spree, killing six people and critically injuring two.

When 19-year-old Kenia disappears, her family immediately begins conducting their own investigation to find her; as the police join them in their efforts, they follow alarming leads that cause them to believe Kenia won't be found alive.

A beloved member of the local community is brutally murdered with part of his body apparently taken as a souvenir by the killer; detectives try to make sense of this horrifying crime despite conflicting stories and a possible false confession.
After a divorced mother is found murdered in her home, police discover she had an unusual array of people involved in her life.
After an elderly woman comes into a large sum of money, she is attacked; investigators uncover a twisted tale of addiction, brutality and betrayal.

After a missing woman is discovered by a deputy to be murdered in the backyard of her family home, investigators must learn whether the victim was killed by a mysterious driver seen lingering outside the house, or someone unexpected.
A U.S. Navy veteran is brutally beaten to death during a home robbery; to find the killer, police must sift through various lies as several suspects desperately attempt to cover their tracks.

When a schoolteacher is gunned down in public, a known felon's DNA and phone records link him to the crime; however, after investigators arrest the man, they discover the real killer might actually be someone else entirely.

Victoria tries to win over the difficult kids of a man she likes, Elka is resistant to wintering in Florida with Max, and Melanie and Joy volunteer at a senior center.
As Victoria interviews the governor's candidly opportunistic wife, Elka goes on trial and attempts to sway the verdict by flirting with an elderly juror.

Elka's on the lam and the women go looking for her…in Amish country.  Meanwhile, Joy's a source of scandal as the Governor's alleged mistress and faces deportation while Victoria finds herself a little too "at home" with the Amish.

Joy learns from a fertility clinic director that Rick is their most sought-after donor, and Victoria method-acts as an old woman to land a prestigious stage role.
Looking for "GBFFs" like they had in L.A., the women go to a gay bar, where Victoria is mistaken for a drag queen, and Elka punches out her former best friend.

When a children's author hosts one last Christmas dinner with her disagreeable siblings before they sell the family house, she reunites with her childhood sweetheart who helps her find a way to keep the home she loves so dearly.
Just before Christmas, Santa's stockman must rush to find a replacement for an injured reindeer. When he locates one, complications and love ensue.

A real estate developer is given the opportunity of his career to transform an old shopping complex into a prime location. Unfortunately, there is one tenant who is holding out—the Christmas shop owner he met by happenstance just days ago.
Two news broadcasters who previously were in love, fight for a position as a morning talk show host that they both want, ultimately finding what made them like each other so much in the first place.

Everyone's heard of Area 51--Groom Lake, Nevada. However, 2,500 miles away there's an underwater facility that's also highly secretive.

Police tapes, video, and the testimony of a radar operator suggest something very strange was seen over Ohio in 1994; Holland, Michigan in 1994; and Millstadt, Illinois in 2000.

programmes.d: Billy Dee Williams escapes from a home in Los Angeles after he has a terrifying encounter with the spirit of a woman who was tragically killed in the home.

Ron and Nancy are convinced that their new home is ideally suited to their budget. But objects start to move by themselves and they learn that their house is a way station between life and death.

programmes.t: One Night Out with Alan Cumming
programmes.d: Tony and Emmy Award-winning actor and icon Alan Cumming takes the Just For Laughs Montréal stage as host of a landmark comedy gala.

A rising artist in New York tests Bette’s commitment while the sperm donor’s girlfriend discovers a lonely Tina and starts harassing her; Tim returns home alone and Jenny gets a ride from two disaffected teenagers.

Relationships can be painful. Tim rejects Jenny, who learns about Marina's other lover; Bette struggles with her fears about parenthood, while Dana runs from her fears and from Lara; Kit is stung when her son doesn’t show up for their meeting.

Identities, sexual and other, are in question as Jenny tries to explain her situation to her one-time roommate; Dana comes out to her right-wing parents, and Bette begins to consider her own self-image.
Jenny is more confused and torn than ever between Marina and Tim; fame and all its complications find Shane; Kit rehearses for a hip hop music video.

An unexpected opportunity eases Tina’s grief while Bette defends the gallery against a right-wing attack; Shane’s relationship with her patrons gets complicated; Marina and Francesca fight, and Jenny tries to help Tim.
Bette prepares for the gallery’s new show and hires Candace, an attractive female contractor, to handle the set-up; Tina, Jenny, Shane, Alice and Dana share an eventful trip to Palm Springs.
Bette lands in jail thanks to a near-riot at the gallery; Marina contemplates life without Francesca as Tim and Jenny discuss divorce.
Tina finds out about Candace; Shane’s patrons turn on her; Dana loses a friend but gains a fiancée, while Kit tries to make sense of Ivan’s attention and her reaction to it.

The second season opens as rumors circulate about Marina’s suicide attempt and her return home to Italy.  This news has a devastating effect on Jenny even as she prepares for an emotional goodbye with Tim who has accepted a coaching job in Ohio.

Tina hires gay-rights lawyer Joyce Wischnia to represent her in the division of assets with Bette. Kit tracks down Ivan at her cabin in the country and proposes a business partnership that Ivan agrees to consider.

Jenny is instantly smitten when she meets her new roommate, Shane’s current love interest, Carmen.  Carmen is both dejected and intrigued by Shane’s inability to open up, but is also attracted to Jenny.

Bette travels to New York for some damage control with Helena Peabody, the new administrator of a foundation that provides financial support to the Art Center. Shane and Jenny interview prospective roommates but can’t quite find the perfect candidate.

As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born.  But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life.  But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.
Ethan Hawke, Uma Thurman, Alan Arkin, and Jude Law star in this engrossing sci-fi thriller about an all-too-human man who dares to defy a system obsessed with genetic perfection.  Rated: PG-13
Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.
Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.
Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.

In the future, mankind has outlawed the things that trigger emotion-literature, music, and art. To uphold the law, a special breed of police is assigned to eliminate all transgressors. Christian Bale stars in this awesome high-tech action thriller.
Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.
She's beautiful, seductive, intelligent, and her charms could spell doom for the entire human race! Ben Kingsley, Forrest Whitaker, and Natasha Henstridge star in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi hit.

Bruce Willis, Milla Jovovich, and Gary Oldman star in acclaimed director Luc Besson's outrageous sci-fi adventure, an extravagantly styled tale of good against evil set in an unbelievable twenty-third-century world.

Jane Grote Abell, Owner of Donato's Pizza, goes undercover to get an inside slice of the family business. The boss learns that the pizzas aren't the only things getting baked at one store. One store's archaic computer system leaves the boss in a bad mood.

Anthony Wedo, CEO of Buffets Inc., travels from his corner office to the back of the house. The boss breaks cover when flooded with a dishwasher's nasty attitude. The high-energy Boss meets his match when faced with an unruly cash register.
When Donnie asks Paul to join a fantasy football league, Paul decides to enlist the help of New England Patriots' Rob Gronkowski.
Mark is in Hong Kong to promote his film--and Johnny "Drama" and Henry "Nacho" are along for the ride. During their stay Mark sends "Drama" to a casting agency to audition for a local commercial.
The entire Wahlberg clan gears up for their favorite local holiday, Dorchester Day--an event that has become the backdrop for some of the family's most infamous pranks.
Donnie is homesick during the New Kids On The Block European tour, so his fiancée Jenny McCarthy, invites his brother Paul to London to cheer him up.
Paul must navigate a jam-packed day including a visit to an oyster farm, an interview with a reporter and a skateboarding event for his son.

Donnie's suggestion, Paul decides to take up woodworking as a hobby to help manage the stress of running the restaurants. Alma, who is terrified Paul is going to hurt himself insists his older brother Arthur try and protect Paul in the dangerous endeavor.

When Mark notices that the restaurants are busier than ever, he asks his bodyguard Scott to go to Boston to look after Alma. Scott soon finds himself out of his element when Alma turns her temporary protector into her new best friend.
Paul and his brother Bob decide to take their sons Ethan and Oscar on a fishing trip in attempt to start a new family tradition.
Jeff wears down sellers by trash-talking their merchandise, then tries to convince buyers that industrial pressure gauges and cheap pink T-shirts are treasures.
Jeff gambles on a series of end-of-the-line deals in hopes of a big payday.
Jeff falls hard for a vintage motorbike. Then when things go wrong with a mechanic, he has to turn to Sheldon the Bailiff to get it back.
Jeff and Daniel travel to the California desert to visit an abandoned town, meet slot machine collectors, and make a deal on 30,000 wine corks.

An Ohio customer fights fast food employees, apparently over a customized drink. A Scottish man has trouble ordering at an Alabama drive-thru. At a New York diner, a server tells off a customer. Thieves try to rob a gun store in Tennessee.
In Florida, a couple is booted from a flight after allegedly refusing to follow instructions. A young girl in California finds herself stuck in a gumball machine.
At a fast food restaurant in South Carolina, a man stands up to what he believes is a rude customer, and things quickly become physical.
A stubborn moviegoer refuses to give up his seat, causing employees to stop the movie and intervene. In Las Vegas, a rideshare driver is unexpectedly attacked by seven passengers.
A plate shatters on a woman's face during a brawl over restaurant seating. A passenger on a flight to Boston begins acting erratically and starts making his way toward the cockpit.

After allegedly skipping the bill at an airport restaurant in Atlanta, a customer causes chaos with a fire extinguisher. A bar patron keeps his cool in St. Louis, Missouri in the face of an armed robber.

Mike White, Chairman, President and CEO of DIRECTV, the world's most popular video service goes undercover in his own company where he discovers that employees are spending their own money for a specific piece of equipment.

Bryan Bedford, Chairman of the Board, President and CEO of Frontier Airlines, goes undercover in his own company, where he "gets christened" while emptying a plane's lavatory and discovers how company-wide pay cuts are impacting his employees.

Steve Phelps, SVP and Chief Marketing Officer for NASCAR, the #1 spectator sport in the U.S., goes undercover with one of the sport's pit crews and also struggles to keep pace working alongside a grounds crew preparing for the "Daytona 500."
Roy immediately regrets bringing his little brother to an auction in Toronto when all his enemies fall for the charming young man.
Ursula’s private investigator husband spies on the buyers at an auction in Markham.
Bogart finally snaps when Paul buys yet another lousy locker at an auction in Toronto’s Liberty Village.

A young American journalist (Margaret Qualley) stranded in Nicaragua seduces an enigmatic Englishman (Joe Alwyn) who seems like her best chance of escape. She soon realizes, though, that their torrid affair has only put her in more danger.

A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief must guide a child to safety through a gauntlet of hostile Taliban insurgents and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

Academy Award Nominee Bruce Dern and Stephen Lang star in this horror tale about a couple renting a vacation home who meet the spirits of the architect and his two wives—plus their deranged, living son.
In this intense Western starring Jack Kilmer, Stephen Dorff, and Cole Hauser, a gunslinger must fight for his life after killing the brother of a corrupt mayor.

A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programmes.d: A mother falls for a younger man while her daughter falls in love for the first time. Mother Nature messes with their fates.

programmes.t: I Don't Know How She Does It
programmes.d: Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) manages the ultimate balancing act between work and her adoring family in this comedy based on the bestseller by Allison Pearson.

A film noir buff to the extreme (Cillian Murphy) is given a taste of his own medicine and has his life turned upside down by a kooky femme fatale (Lucy Liu) with a big adventure in mind. Sometimes love is stranger than fiction.

From the director of Knocked Up comes a comedic look at an American family as one couple (Paul Rudd and Leslie Mann) tries to balance romance, parenting, and children in their own hilarious ways.

Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.
A comic story about the annual holiday gathering of a New England family, the Stones.
Morgana summons the mighty Callieach to tear open the veil between the worlds.
Morgana's blinkered determination threatens not only Arthur's future, but the very balance of the world.
The mighty citadel is buzzing in anticipation of the prince's birthday celebrations.
The mysterious Julius Borden arrives in Camelot with news of a magical secret.
Arthur faces his first true test as King when he incurs the wrath of the formidable Queen Annis.
When Merlin falls into Morgana's hands, he becomes a deadly weapon in her fight for supremacy.
Can anyone stop Morgana before Merlin's greatest secret is revealed?
A mysterious illness draws Merlin to a distant village.
Gwen must fight temptation before she commits an unspeakable act of betrayal.

When a plot to kill Bash goes wrong, Queen Catherine is suspected of orchestrating it.  Mary offers to help free a wrongly imprisoned pregnant peasant named Isobel who has a mysterious tie to Bash.
When King Henry accuses Queen Catherine of treason and adultery, she sets out to save her life by exposing Bash's dark past.
When Clarissa kidnaps the younger children of King Henry and Queen Catherine, Mary and Bash work with the Queen to find them, with tragic results.
With a forced marriage looming, Mary must consider both her heart and her nation when deciding whom she will wed - Francis or Bash - when Francis returns to court with Lola at his side.

Mary returns from her honeymoon and, suspicious of Lola's strange behavior, uncovers a deception that changes everything.  Bash encounters a confused and terrified Olivia, an escaped victim of the terrors of the woods.
The castle is abuzz with First Light, where the women of the castle mingle with potential suitors. Much to Mary's dismay, Lola is reluctant to participate in the tradition.
The Alternate Fringe team investigates a bioterrorist armed with an insect that has a taste for human flesh.  And Walternate discovers a line he will not cross.
A series of Fringe events leads the team to the home of a woman grieving over the death of her husband, while Peter and Olivia try to repair the emotional rift between them.
The Fringe team revisits the past.
The Fringe Team investigates a group of thieves who can break the laws of gravity. Meanwhile, Walter attempts to delay the damage he's caused to the fabric of the universe.
When the Fringe Team investigates an apparent suicide victim, they uncover a second set of fingerprints, leading them to a woman with uncanny characteristics that cannot die.
Olivia endures life "over there."
The team tries to extract Bell's consciousness out of Olivia.
Walternate finds a way to wreak havoc "over here."
A suspicious cosmonaut crashes on Citizen Z's station, putting him on high alert.
Split off from the others, Mack and Addy find themselves trapped by a zombie they just can't kill.
The team desperately tries to stop a nuclear meltdown in a plant full of radiated zombies.
In need of shelter and supplies, the team seeks refuge in an all-female compound where men are not allowed.
When someone close to Major dies of an apparent suicide, Liv consumes the brains, resulting in a mix of reality and paranoia.

programmes.st: Dead Rat, Live Rat, Brown Rat, White Rat
programmes.d: After Liv consumes the brain of a teenage girl, she is taken back to high school as she and Clive investigate the case. Major believes Blaine's deli is not all it seems to be.
In the season finale, Liv and Clive pay a visit to Vaughn Du Clark (STEVEN WEBER) at Max Rager HQ after discovering new evidence. Blaine makes Liv an offer she can't refuse.
In the season premiere, Ravi suspects Major might be experiencing a side effect of the cure, and Liv pays Blaine a surprise visit. Liv consumes the brain of a cantankerous old man.
Liv and Detective Babineax investigate the shocking murder of a hard-partying frat boy. ROBERT KNEPPER (Prison Break) guest stars as a mysterious person from Blaine's past.
The Sun is our star. Its energy enables life on the Earth to thrive yet we know so little about the solar weather and the 11 year solar cycle.
Space telescopes orbiting above the distorting effects of the Earth's atmosphere, such as the Hubble, have made incredible contributions to our knowledge of the universe.
There are so many unanswered questions about the stars, the galaxies and the universe and just mapping what lies in the night sky is immensely difficult.
As our expertise in space technology increases there have been spin-offs in many areas: particularly in communications.
The world of soft robotics, where robots are so human-like they can actually feel things.
The STEM initiative is getting a big boost from both the private, and public, sectors.
Chuck Pell has a conversation in real-time with a hologram of a holocaust survivor.
Future tech is changing the basics of human existence, including our five senses.
Sustainability is a word you’re going to hear a lot more of on the road to 2050.
Artificial Intelligence, or ‘AI’, is all the rage among futurists.
Solar power is the fastest growing power source in the world.

programmes.st: Future Tech Goes Back In Time
programmes.d: Join host Chuck Pell as Virtual Reality technology recreates ancient cities.

Mobsters, jazz, and turbulent economic times mark the 1920s. Silent film makes the transition to the talkies as sound comes to the silver screen.  Criminals find that there's one less place to hide with the invention of the lie detector.
Though overshadowed by the Great Depression, there is no shortage of ingenuity in the 1930s. The two-way radio gets miniaturized, and the world's first portable walkie-talkie goes on the air.

War is the driving force behind much of the innovation in the 1940s.  The microwave is born after a self-taught inventor realizes that military equipment is responsible for melting a chocolate bar in his pocket.
The 1950s heralds the end of vacuum tubes and the rise of mobile technologies when two Japanese inventors shrink cabinet-size radios down to something small enough to fit in your pocket.
Even before the start of recorded history, ancient engineers were erecting giant monuments.

programmes.st: The Taj Mahal & The Golden Age Of Islam
programmes.d: Awe-inspiring palaces are the legacy that demonstrates the brilliance of Islamic engineers.
Stadiums have been regarded as architectural masterpieces, none more so than the Colosseum in Rome.
How gold is mined and transformed into everyday objects like jewelry and currency.
Naked Science follows the story of a diamond from the creation of carbon inside the heart of a dying sun, through to the cutting of a diamond mine in South Africa.

programmes.st: Inside The Mind Of Stephen Hawking
programmes.d: Stephen Hawking, though suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis has developed a unique understanding of the universe.
Driven by sensual photography, trance-like music, and droll humor, Jim Jarmusch’s ONLY LOVERS LEFT ALIVE is a meditation on art, science, and the mysteries of everlasting love.

Based on a true story, two brothers, against all the odds, come together to train for a historic title bout that has the power to reunite their fractured family and give their hard-luck town what it's been waiting for: pride.
A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.
The fastest hands in the East meet the biggest mouth in the West when legendary martial arts daredevil Jackie Chan teams with comedic powerhouse Chris Tucker in Rush Hour.
While vacationing together in Hong Kong, fast-talking LAPD Detective Carter and Hong Kong Police Inspector Lee investigate when a bomb explodes in the American embassy.

Set in Paris, Rush Hour 3 finds Chris Tucker and Jackie Chan's misfit partners from West and East battling a wing of the Chinese organized crime family of the Triads -- with their trademark mix of great action and big laughs.
A detached man and his friend organize brutal, bare-knuckle boxing matches.
Leon loses his radio show because of his X-rated on-air comments. He then gets a letter from a former flame promising him a lifetime of wealth and happiness, and things start looking up!
When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.
Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.
A young reporter happens upon a series of gruesome murders tied to real estate mysteries, where entire rooms have been dismantled and pulled from their foundations.
Following a mysterious disappearance on a jump, a group of skydivers experience paranormal occurrences that leave them fighting for their lives.

In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

A woman must return to the fundamentalist compound where she was raised after the vengeful spirit of a cursed witch haunts her.
A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.

programmes.d: In 18th-century France lived Jean-Baptiste Grenouille, who was born with a great sense of smell. But as his gift becomes an obsession, he strives to create the most intoxicating perfume in the world by murdering young women to capture their essence.

A former Army Ranger, now working as a DEA agent, is called in to investigate the disappearance of a drill sergeant and several cadets during a training mission that went disastrously wrong in the Panamanian jungle.

When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.
East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.
Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.
A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

John Rambo is sent on an assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

Rambo refuses to join his friend and former mentor, Colonel Trautman, on a mission to Afghanistan. The mission fails, and Russian troops capture Trautman. Now Rambo must infiltrate the Russian fortress to save his only friend.

The entire Enterprise crew is knocked unconscious by a plundering Ferengi crew through a Trojan horse gas canister, leaving the ship to be easily ransacked.

Wrongfully imprisoned for ignorantly trespassing, Archer and Mayweather are taken prisoner by the Tandarans and find themselves in a Suliban internment camp.

From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.
Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.
Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.
Finally arriving at the paradise of planet Risa, the Enterprise crew is able to enjoy two days and nights of much needed shore leave.
The temporal cold war heats us as Captain Archer is taken to the 31st century by the Sulibans.
