Bounty hunters from the future transport a doomed race car driver to New York City in 2009, where his mind will be replaced with that of a dead billionaire.
Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.
Two Fern Gully faeries leave the rain forest to save three baby animals from poachers.
A small-town sheriff (Nick Nolte) becomes unhinged, thanks in part to his abusive, alcoholic father (James Coburn).

programmes.t: The Return of Hunter: Everyone Walks in L.A.
programmes.d: Los Angeles police lieutenant Rick Hunter (Fred Dryer) seeks the media-hungry serial killer (Miguel Ferrer) who killed his fiancée.
An offbeat Ohio teenager (Winona Ryder) eagerly awaits the return of a legendary wild one she figures is her mother.
The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.
Pygmy dinosaurs help the owner (Fred Willard) of a miniature golf course fight off bank foreclosure and takeover by his greedy brother (Bruce Weitz).
An insecure young woman (Marissa Ribisi) and her promiscuous best friend (Juliette Lewis) seek relationships.
An evil corporation planning an inescapable global computer network hires a mentally impaired laborer (Matt Frewer) made into a genius by virtual reality.
An evil archaeologist tries to exploit five pygmy dinosaurs that hatched in a family's basement.
San Francisco yuppies (Melanie Griffith, Matthew Modine) restore a costly Victorian, then rent a studio to a landlord's nightmare (Michael Keaton).
A 1920s playboy returns from a stint in the French Foreign Legion to reclaim his lover, a mobster's mistress.
A space hero (Reb Brown) puts down mutineers (John Phillip Law, James Ryan) on a huge ship taking earthlings to a far planet.
Filmmaker Richard Linklater uses a string of mostly amateur actors to show varieties of a type: the new bohemian.
An evil archaeologist tries to exploit five pygmy dinosaurs that hatched in a family's basement.
Miniature dinosaurs help a boy outwit a malevolent governess who wants to pack him off to a military boarding school.
Pygmy dinosaurs help the owner (Fred Willard) of a miniature golf course fight off bank foreclosure and takeover by his greedy brother (Bruce Weitz).
While on a desert excursion, a family encounters cultists who use human hands as sacrificial offerings to their god.
A small-town sheriff (Nick Nolte) becomes unhinged, thanks in part to his abusive, alcoholic father (James Coburn).
A lumberjack helps a tribe of rain-forest elves protect their kingdom from an evil spirit and greedy clear-cutters.
Filmmaker John Carpenter introduces a trio of terror tales: "Unleaded," "Hair" and Tobe Hooper's "Baseball Man."

Fernanda, Marleny y Jonathan son víctimas de préstamos digitales que se convierten en cobros intimidantes. Séptimo Día investiga Call Centers que usan tácticas de intimidación para cobrar deudas. Las autoridades y expertos advierten sobre los riesgos de estas aplicaciones.
Los venezolanos que cometen delitos en Colombia generan un polémico debate sobre qué hacer.

Angie Sandoval perdió a su perro Alejandro, robado en Suba. La indiferencia social ante el robo fue evidente. En Colombia, el maltrato animal aumentó un 41% en el último año. La senadora Andrea Padilla busca esclarecer la ley para proteger mejor a los animales.

Casos de negligencia y posibles abusos bajo el cuidado del ICBF exponen un sistema en crisis: muertes sin esclarecer, custodias fallidas y maltrato en hogares infantiles plantean graves dudas sobre la protección real de la infancia en Colombia.
Ricky Cardona relata el caso en el que un intento de robo terminó en devastación.

El 14 de julio de 2013, la familia Mazo fue masacrada a machete en el barrio Villa Laura, Comuna 13, Medellín. Cuatro integrantes murieron, pero un niño de 11 años sobrevivió escondido bajo una cama, convirtiéndose en testigo clave. Aunque el motivo del ataque nunca se esclareció, las pruebas presentadas por la Fiscalía permitieron identificar a los responsables del crimen.

Sandra seduce y manipula a su joven amante Gyan Carlos, convenciéndolo de asesinar a su esposo Mauricio a cambio de amor y una vida juntos. Sin saberlo, Gyan Carlos no era el único hombre bajo su control. Tras el crimen, errores de novatos facilitaron la investigación, llevando tanto a Sandra como a su amante a pagar una larga condena en prisión.

El 28 de febrero de 2016, Helen Gordillo (9) fue asesinada en Villeta. Un mes después, Israel Rodríguez, vecino de la niña, fue capturado. El crimen habría sido por venganza, tras una discusión con la abuela de Helen por una deuda.

En 2009, Islanis fue asesinada a los 21 años. El principal sospechoso, alias "Betún", reveló que el verdadero autor intelectual era Jonatán Pérez, un cabo del Ejército, quien la mató al enterarse de su embarazo, temiendo el impacto en su carrera militar. En 2011, Pérez fue condenado a 40 años de prisión por homicidio agravado.

El alcalde Gentil Bahamón, elegido con récord de votos en Suaza, Huila, fue asesinado brutalmente. Su esposa, en complicidad con dos amantes, planeó el crimen para cobrar un seguro. Nueve años después, el caso aún causa indignación.
El 05 de marzo del 2010, en la vereda Oro Perdido, del municipio de Cáqueza, una familia humilde y trabajadora terminan siendo víctima de un sangriento asesinato.

Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.
Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.
Alexa está demandando a su novio de un año y medio por cancelar abruptamente el viaje de su vida porque necesitaba traer a su hijo de 7 años.
Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

En Colombia, el COVID-19 deja cientos de familias rotas. Andrea Peña perdió a sus padres y hermano en pocos días; Pilar Rivera se despidió de su esposo tras 28 años juntos; y Elvis Parra perdió a sus dos padres y dos hermanos en solo 15 días. Con más de 80 mil familias en duelo, el país enfrenta un dolor colectivo mientras urge el autocuidado y el distanciamiento.

Gustavo Petró, periodista brasileño de tecnología en São Paulo, recibe diariamente entre 50 y 100 mensajes ofensivos en Twitter debido a la confusión con su homónimo, el político colombiano Gustavo Petro. Aunque le divierte la situación, también teme por su familia. Los Informantes reunió a ambos hombres para hablar sobre cómo es compartir nombre con alguien tan diferente y controvertido.
Adrian revela su secreto de infidelidad: ¿es Benjamin el padre de su hijo? Heather vuelve para otra prueba de ADN con Robert. ¿Qué dirán los resultados?
La furiosa mamá Patty quiere demostrar que el novio de su hija, Dale, un hombre que duplica la edad de su hija, ha sido infiel. ¿Entonces Bam fue infiel a Brianna en su propia cama?
La adolescente Megan vive con su antiguo novio controlador Rick. Megan no puede ir a la escuela, buscar trabajo, ni comer sin su permiso. ¿Pueden su tía y Steve lograr hacerla entender?

El hijo de Kimberly nació con una rara enfermedad y ella sospecha que su padre robaba para su tratamiento. A Avonte le diagnosticaron cáncer poco común y no recibió nada de la recaudación que organizó su tía Terceira.

Tras sobrevivir a una loca persecución en coche, perder la pierna y estar en coma a causa de su esposo, Portia finalmente lo confrontará. No admitirá la culpa, pero hoy Steve está ayudando a Portia a hacerse oír.
Torrance admite haber sido infiel a su novia con un giro sorprendente. Entonces, Heather quiere que Tramisha, el ex de su novio, deje de interferir en su relación.
Una mujer se acuesta con el novio de su hermana gemela; un hombre queda atrapado entre dos mujeres; un hombre le pide a un amigo que mienta por él.

Jaycee le demuestra a Brandy que nunca es correcto ser infiel y arruinar a una familia. Casi cree que su prometido podría aprender una lección de Kevin, un antiguo invitado. Además, concertamos una cita entre la espectadora Tamara y el invitado Nathan.
Shianne confiesa que fue infiel a Mistress Delicious con su mamá Blonde. Después, la madre del bebé de Chris se enfrenta a él por dejarla por su compañera de trío.

Kenny se junta con una mujer que lo presiona para tener una relación, pero tiene una sorpresa para ella: la posesiva Kelsey confronta a su novio y a la mujer con la que se acostó en una fiesta en una casa; Jeremy quiere terminar su relación.

Paraísos naturales se vuelven escenarios de tragedia por empresas informales, guías sin capacitación y falta de control. Vidas como las de José, Liliana y Andrea se apagaron, mientras familias claman justicia y mayor regulación.

Yiset Silva y Lisandro Rodríguez enfrentan un misterio tras el parto de su hija el 31 de diciembre de 2020 en Armenia. La clínica dice que la bebé nació sin vida, pero la familia cree que está viva. Inconsistencias en la historia clínica y una necropsia sin órganos aumentan sus dudas. La Fiscalía investiga.
A pesar de los esfuerzos para promover el turismo, hay un número creciente de ataques en Colombia.
Los padres luchan por mantener a sus hijos adolescentes y preadolescentes a salvo de los peligros de Internet.

Jhon Ferney, condenado por feminicidio en 2015, muestra los efectos de la celopatía, trastorno originado en la infancia por la falta de afecto. Su historia revela cómo los celos enfermizos y una relación tóxica desembocaron en tragedia.

Hogares convertidos en escenarios de violencia. Historias de arrendatarios que ocultan secretos, mientras familias vulnerables enfrentan tragedias impensables. En un país donde el arriendo es necesidad, la confianza se paga con vidas y silencio.

Desde su inicio en 1996, Séptimo Día ha sido un referente del periodismo investigativo en Colombia. Historias arriesgadas, denuncias impactantes y la valentía de sus reporteros han marcado el rumbo de una televisión que no teme confrontar la verdad.

Desde los 12 años, una niña fue abusada por un pariente que luego se convirtió en su asesino. Jorge Alonso, tras evadir a la policía por 7 años y cambiar de identidad, fue capturado y espera juicio en Bucaramanga.

En 2013, María Isabel Delgado y su hija Selena desaparecieron en Pasto, Nariño. Tras días de búsqueda, se reveló que Milton, esposo de María Isabel y también su primo, las había asesinado para ocultar que era padre de otra bebé fruto de una relación extramarital secreta. Los cuerpos fueron hallados enterrados con señales de violencia. Milton fue declarado autor intelectual del doble homicidio y condenado a 33 años de prisión.

Jessica Mayerli Alza, una estudiante de 16 años, es hallada desmembrada dentro de una maleta en el sur de Bogotá. La investigación reveló que Andrea, su mejor amiga, la asesinó al descubrir que Jessica sostenía una relación con su esposo, Leimar. Autoridades sospechan que Andrea tuvo cómplices en el crimen. Un año después, Andrea Valdez Contreras fue condenada a 345 meses de prisión por homicidio agravado.

Óscar es asesinado en su cuarto. Al principio parecía suicidio, pero su amigo Yeison fue arrestado y reveló que la ex esposa, Paola, lo mandó matar por el seguro. Yeison recibe 17 años de cárcel. Paola proclama su inocencia.

En La Virginia, Risaralda, Heidy Yuliani Restrepo, una niña de 11 años, desapareció el 31 de diciembre de 2013 y fue hallada muerta días después en un caño. La investigación señaló a su propia madre, María Preselia Martínez, como responsable del crimen, motivado presuntamente por la pérdida de una sim card. Fue condenada por homicidio agravado y cumple su condena en la cárcel de mujeres La Badea, en Pereira.
Edenis Barrera Benavides, líder social y voluntaria de la Defensa Civil, fue brutalmente asesinada en 2014.
Guadalupe está demandando a Thomas, el dueño de una tienda de vestidos de Quinceañera, por dolor y sufrimiento más el costo del vestido que es de $4,500.
Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

Edward Rincón y Weimar Castro, primos de 19 años, fueron víctimas de "falsos positivos": jóvenes inocentes asesinados por el ejército y presentados como guerrilleros caídos en combate. En 2004, desaparecieron tras salir con una amiga y fueron hallados acribillados. Sus madres, Inés y Beatriz, llevan 17 años luchando por justicia, enfrentando amenazas mientras buscan la verdad sobre lo ocurrido a sus hijos.

Tres historias: Gina Sharik Ávila, adolescente colombiana, padece el raro síndrome Kleine-Levin, "la bella durmiente", que la sume en sueños de hasta 70 días. Augusto Pinochet Molina III, nieto del dictador chileno, defiende el legado de su abuelo en medio de las protestas de 2019. Camilo Herrera, tras quebrar en 2008, fundó "Un Litro de Luz", llevando iluminación solar con botellas recicladas a comunidades de más de 23 países.

Después de meses de rogar y suplicar, Latoya perdonó a Justice por su infidelidad. ¡Pero ahora han vuelto para someterlo a juicio por lo mismo! Después, puede que James sea demasiado bueno para ser verdad... ¿Está siendo infiel a Santa? ¿Qué dirán las pruebas del detector de mentiras?

Kayla deja que su prometido Toby viva con ella, sus hijos y Lyndsey, la mamá de sus bebés. ¿La engaña con Lyndsey? Además, la relación de 15 años de Geisha con Indo peligra si él admite ser proxeneta y engañarla con su colega.

In postwar Vienna, Austria, Holly Martins, a writer of pulp Westerns, arrives penniless as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has died. Seymour works in a skid row florist shop and is in love with his beautiful co-worker, Audrey. He creates a new plant that not only talks but cannot survive without human flesh and blood.

Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.

Matt treats a patient burnt in a work-place explosion, but bad weather jeopardises the flight to hospital. Nat presses Leonard to propose marriage. Mark struggles with a misbehaving driver who’s crashed into a pole.

Every second counts as paramedics try to reach an unconscious patient by breaking into her house. Mark and Carina treat a man with a life-threatening condition, where the only way to save him is to stop his heart.

A mysterious young woman found unresponsive on a bus has Carina baffled. Matt becomes concerned after a frightened car crash survivor loses her memory. Risky and Nicola are confronted by an unwanted intruder.

Mark races to help a young father in danger of losing his arm, following a horrific workplace accident. After a car crash leaves a trail of destruction creating chaos, Nat and Leonard are shocked by a patient’s surprising revelation.

The heat descends into chaos as the house robots team up to take down the competitors. The judges make a controversial decision in the final to decide this week’s winner.
Over halfway through the heats and the hopefuls are still lining up to put their robots through mechanical hell, for a chance of making it to the semi-finals.
An apparent malfunction gives a veteran competitor an opportunity to redeem themselves in the eliminators. The World Champion returns to take on the Pinball Warrior.
Sparks fly in this week’s heat as competitors put their weapons to good use and a robot uses its shape to their advantage.

The eliminator begins slowly, but as the battle heats up the robots must stay cool, or they might end up losing their head. The house robots see one of their busiest nights in the arena as they try to keep up.
Celebrities take to the arena, teaming up with veterans from the series and their robots. The celebrities must control the robots for at least 60 seconds before the professionals can take over.

Four teams take part in the tag team terror tournament. Two teams comprised of two robots enter the arena at once. Only one robot is allowed to battle, only being able to switch with their team-mate by entering their team’s coloured zone.

Northerners compete in an annihilator. In the first round, all six robots would fight each other until one of them was eliminated. The process continued until only two robots remained, with the subsequent winner becoming the annihilator champion.
The South’s turn for the annihilator. Same rules, different robots.
The UK and USA battle it out to prove which country has the better robots. Each country has four robots representing and fighting for them. A straight knockout competition will determine a victor.
The heats resume this week, and one competitor has its own entrance ceremony. Gemini returns to the arena to prove themselves in Pinball Warrior.
Renowned robot Firestorm 2 takes on Pinball Warrior this week and the heats are nearing their end. The house robots show no mercy against a flipped robot.
Not even the arena floor is safe in this week’s eliminators, as the competitors go all out to best the opposition. One robot manages to take control in the heat finals.

An impressive weapon manages to fight off two robots simultaneously, ripping through armor and insides. As one of the finalists is still reeling from the previous rounds, will they manage to come back and take the finals?
Heat winners gather for the beginning of The Fourth Wars semi-finals. Pinball Warrior and Sumo Bash make way for the brutal knockout competition.
The last stage before the Grand Finals, and the pressure is on. With this level of carnage not all robots may leave the arena as they fight for the title, and their lives.
The Fourth Wars is coming to an end, beginning with two rounds of playoffs, where four will be whittled down to two. Of the remaining two, one will become Robot Wars: The Fourth Wars champions.

This show features an eclectic collection of home-made robots, one designed by a nine year old and another constructed out of wood. Some competitors from the Classic series return to the arena.
In this show we see the former Holiday camp Bluecoats daring to flip two of the House Robots with their ‘launcher’ Apollo. The most expensive Robot in the Series competes in this Heat.
This features one of the most bizarre but certainly the tallest robot ever seen on Robot Wars, Gabriel, built my Mensa member Craig and his three sons.
In this show the heat winners in shows 1 to 5 come back to fight again. The judges must choose one Wild Card from the runners up to join them.

Furious over Soo and Hoon's deception, Gae Ttong refuses to remain a noble lady. But Moon Seok warns that many lives depend on her becoming queen. After a beautiful day with Hoon, she prepares to say goodbye.
Gae Ttong enters the second queen selection, but an astrologist claims she has the fortune of the dead. Soo discovers a political scheme, while Kang and Young Soo are taken in for interrogation.
The Chief and Second State Councillors plot treason. Gae Ttong is kidnapped to force Hoon's cooperation, while Young Soo is imprisoned. Joon uses all his resources to find where they are being held.
Flower Crew, Joseon's top matchmaking agency, consists of Ma Hoon, Young Soo, and Do Joon. While working on a case, they meet Gae Ttong. Soon after, blacksmith Kim Soo asks Flower Crew for help.
Flower Crew agrees to arrange Gae Ttong and Soo's wedding. Everything goes smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to find him, but their search seems hopeless.
Hoon allows Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. After losing clients, the crew takes a case involving scholar Lee Hyung Gyu, but Hoon suspects he is hiding something.

Hoon lets Gae Ttong stay at the house again, and subtle feelings grow between them. Gae Ttong promises to leave if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee. Meanwhile, Soo orders an investigation into the Crown Prince's murder.

Hoon is taken to the palace and discovers that Soo is now the king. Soo asks him to protect Gae Ttong. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong volunteers to pose as a noble lady to help Flower Crew with Scholar Lee's marriage.
Hoon is flustered by Gae Ttong's unexpected kiss, but she remembers nothing the next morning. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks her to deliver his napchae documents to his bride's home, but she refuses.
The Rogue dies mysteriously in prison, leaving Hoon with the words "Fox Guard." Hoon and Joon search for the killer. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong reunites with her brother Kang, raising Ji Hwa's suspicions.
Soo finally reunites with Gae Ttong and promises to marry her. However, Hoon realizes he has feelings for her. Meanwhile, his investigation into the Rogue's death leads him closer to the truth.

Realizing Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father, Hoon agrees to arrange her marriage to Soo. Meanwhile, Flower Crew begins the difficult task of transforming Gae Ttong into a proper noble lady.

Gae Ttong continues her training to become a noble lady. Joon helps Lady Yim and realizes his memories of his mother were wrong. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor discovers that Soo has been deceiving him.
Gae Ttong suddenly confesses her love to Hoon. While Hoon tries to avoid her, Soo grows anxious after overhearing them. He meets Lady Kang and asks Lord Kang to speed up the royal wedding.
Hoon and Gae Ttong confess their love, but a marriage ban is declared until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Lord Kang investigates Flower Crew and discovers Young Soo's true identity.

Hoon tells Soo that his marriage to Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang forces Gae Ttong into the queen selection process using her secret against her. At the palace, Gae Ttong finally learns Soo's true identity.

Walt has a business proposition for original Ghostbuster, Ernie Hudson; a customer wants to sell cartoon shampoo bottles from the 1960s.
Adam West visits and a race between the Batmobile and Black Beauty ensues; a customer sells the first appearance of Rocket Raccoon.
Artist Neal Adams and writer Denny O'Neil visit the Stash; the guys see a set of 50-year-old Batman night lights.
Butch Patrick (Eddie Munster) stops by the Stash; a never officially released rare Star Wars action figure.
Kevin's assistant, Ashley, learns about comic book retail at the Stash; pro wrestlers want to sell their comic.
Darryl McDaniels of Run-DMC brings his new comic to the Stash; the guys look at a Marvel Silver Age number one issue.
Billy Dee Williams stops by the store to win the Millennium Falcon the same way Lando lost it: a high-stakes card game.
Jason Mewes hangs out and plays clerk at the Stash; Walt wants to acquire a mysterious recreation of comic book art.
The guys attend a KISS concert; Walt lives out his childhood dream of meeting Gene Simmons; Ming considers buying an arcade cabinet.
Peter Mayhew ("Chewbacca") judges a Wookiee contest at the Stash; one of the hottest comic books of the 1990s.
Mike flies in the Batcopter to celebrate fifteen years at the Secret Stash; the guys look at one of the hottest books of the '90s.
Kevin talks comics with actor William Shatner; Walt covets a Mego doll that has unique packaging.
The guys and Bryan visit a "Jaws" museum; super-powered toilet paper comes through.
The guys are prompted to reconsider their preparations for the apocalypse by a zombie comic; an eccentric collector wants Walt's help.
Stan Lee helps a customer who is experiencing a comics crisis; a customer buys a classic issue of Fantastic Four.
Secret Stash employees audition with Walt and Bryan for a role in the claymation film they are making with Brian Quinn.
Comics artist, John Romita, Jr., draws an original piece for the Stash; Bryan shows interest in an Evel Knievel toy from his childhood.
Inspired by an old friend, the guys wear cowboy hats, and celebrate the old Wild West; a customer is searching for an iconic comic from the '80s.
Artist Jim Lee shares tales from the world of comics on the podcast; a comic book brings wedding bells to the Stash.
When Ming gets a selfie stick, he tries to go viral by filming the Stash; Walt examines bootleg toys of an '80s blockbuster.
Jason Mewes brings his infant daughter to the Stash to meet everyone; a customer sells comic book Slurpee cups.
Real-life superhero, Phoenix Jones, visits the store and patrols Red Bank with the guys; Walt reminisces about a Batman playset.
Walt and the boys go on a trip to cross off a bucket-list item; four key Spider-Man issues come to the Stash.
The Stash sponsors a blood drive at the shop with the help of horror queen Elvira; the boys discuss the joys of "Mystery Science Theater 3000."
When a vintage 1980s Pac-Man game lands on the counter, Ming prepares for battle; a rare Beatles board game excites the guys.
KITT from "Knight Rider" pulls up to the Stash; a rare Green Arrow Mego figure and Archie Bunker's grandson.
Lindsay Wagner ("The Bionic Woman") stops in for a Silver Surfer item; Jem and Ghostbusters toys spark another round of banter.
Ming and a customer joust over the price of Batman 111; Wolverine becomes the largest statue to ever enter the Stash.
Kevin and Harley visit for the Yoga Hosers premiere; Ming becomes a lead villain with help from a special-effects makeup legend.
Members of the 501st Legion of Stormtroopers invade the Stash looking for new recruits; the fate of a vintage Ewok playset.
Ralph Macchio seeks a rare "Karate Kid" playset; Ming gets an unforgettable lesson; Walt gets excited about a Mechagodzilla.
The guys prepare for a maritime adventure when the Batboat docks in Red Bank; Batman's first appearance.
Jason Mewes inserts himself into transactions involving a Deadshot statue and a vintage Death Star Space Station.
Actress Katrina Law ("Arrow") wants a copy of Batman 232; old school items involving Popeye, Dynomutt and Pogs.
Walt steps into the ring with a customer over an original Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Robots game; a rare piece of original Sal Buscema art.
Marky Ramone shares his artwork and bonds with Walt over robots; a King Kong item from 1975.
A Kreskin ESP game reveals Walt's powers of cognition; discussions about Mork from Ork and Dick Tracy's Rogues' Gallery.
Tom Cavanaugh visits the shop; Walt finds a Golden Age classic with "Human Torch No. 2."
Kevin Smith and the guys discuss how "The Walking Dead" started out as a comic book and became a cultural phenomenon.
Legendary horror icon Robert Englund, aka Freddy Krueger, personally delivers a birthday present to Ming.
The Stash & Red Bank cosplayers celebrate the centennial of Jack Kirby; one of the greatest innovators in comic book history.
Influential actor and rapper Method Man talks to the guys about his extensive comic book collection; "Starsky & Hutch" gear takes over The Stash.
Jay & Silent Bob cosplayers take over the streets of Red Bank; the Comic Book Men attempt to make history by setting a Guinness World Record.
Rare and interesting Star Wars items making their way into the Stash; Walt offers up big cash to try and score a beacon for the store.
Kevin Smith and the guys attend the premiere screening of a movie about themselves and the origination of the film "Clerks."
Actor Burt Ward, best known for portraying television's famous Robin the Boy Wonder, reminisces about his time on the set of "Batman" and judges the Stash's canine cosplay contest.
Walt meets his match during a heated negotiation with actor Mike Colter ("Luke Cage"); a "legendary" video game becomes both Walt's trash and Ming's treasure.
Troma Entertainment co-founder Lloyd Kaufman and his crew put the guys through a grueling audition to see if they have what it takes to be in a Troma film.
The boys take a field trip to the Pez Museum to determine if Walt is actually the owner of an extremely rare and valuable piece of Pez history.
When Walt learns that Ming befriended actor Michael Gray ("Shazam!"), he decides that he must meet the "Mighty Mortal."
Kevin and the boys attend the grand opening of Funko's new headquarters, where they get honored with their very own Pop! figures.
Walt challenges the staff to a flea market sales competition.
Kevin rallies the Stash for a game of street hockey; hurricane Mewes blows through the Stash, and no one is safe.
Walt wants the Stash to shoot its first commercial and to have Bryan direct it; one customer brings in a fanboy's dream.
Walt reluctantly lets Ming run a new sales promotion for the Stash based around zombies, but Ming's scary idea might be too frightening for Walt.
Walt and the guys take a road trip to an unexpected convention; the guys find a treasure in the trash; a customer brings in an item Mike wants for himself.
Ming dares Walt, Bryan and Mike to get tattoos; one customer looks for romance while another makes a deal.
Walt and the guys throw a birthday party at the Stash; larger-than-life Darth Vader helmet.
The guys attend a local auction; bad results from mixing comic books and cigars.
The guys pursue the Jersey Devil; selling Thundercat figures.

programmes.d: Chuck visits Winnipeg, the largest urban Indigenous population in Canada and learns about Metis cuisine. In this city of contrasts, Chuck meets with passionate indigenous residents who help make this food desert a better place with the help of a community oven.
Chef Anna Olson loves cheese bread. She bakes up three different and delicious styles proving cheese and bread are a match made in heaven.

Host Sarah Sharratt dives into the French love of oysters. She visits the windswept Atlanic coast, with its epic sand dunes, breathtaking views, and famous oyster farms. Sarah gets a hands-on lesson in oyster harvesting and places a bid at the famous fish auction in Arcachon. A stop in at St. Emilion to pick up some white wine is the last stop before Sarah heads home to prepare a sea-inspired meal.

A trip to a prehistoric cave site with drawings dating back 20,000 years gets host Sarah Sharratt thinking about the earliest hunters and gatherers, man and fire, and the fundamental need we still have to source and cook our food. In this season finale, Sarah hosts a BBQ party for her visiting family and new French friends.

Jamie starts by cooking up his Tikka Chicken - it’s the quickest roast you’ll ever make. Next, there’s a vibrant carrot and grain salad you can whip up in minutes, and super speedy crab spaghetti—a luxurious and uncomplicated date night dinner.

Jamie’s sharing his super-fast, stress-free, Easy Sausage Carbonara with a quick hack for a powerful peppery punch. Followed by Thai red chicken soup, a spicy one-pot supper that’s the easiest dish you’ll ever make.
In the boreal forest, Jenn learns about the cultural significance of foraging in Indigenous culture and how different plants can be stored and used in both teas and food.
Chef Anna Olson shares her three favourite recipes for no-bake treats. These are the perfect treats to whip up when you don’t want to turn the oven on.

Savour the flavours of France in this indulgent episode! Kirsten bakes golden honey madeleines, a rich and comforting date pudding, and a creamy, irresistible ice cream. To top it off, she answers a common baking dilemma: how to rescue split cream or ganache.
Chef Jamie Oliver makes a quick lamb tagine with pan-fried eggplant and cumin crunch, plus a crispy chicken Caesar salad.

Jess heads to Mum Foods Smokehouse & Delicatessen to explore the craft behind exceptional pastrami. Inspired, she walks viewers through her own achievable take at home, simplifying the curing and smoking process while still delivering that signature deli-style flavour.

Self-taught Felicia has expanded her successful home-based cake business into a full-scale Toronto bakery, but the customers just aren’t coming.  She needs Steve’s help to gain the professional baking skills she didn’t learn online or she risks closing her doors forever!

Italian home cooks learn from a young age that resourcefulness in the kitchen can save the day, and the bank. The art of breathing fresh new life into leftovers is one of the most valuable things Silvia's mother ever taught me in the kitchen. To prove it, after she cooks beautiful zucchini pasta... Silvia and her mother (via Facetime) take the leftovers and completely reinvent them as a delicious homemade Spaghetti Frittata.

The Sunday lunch in Italy is a truly special family food ritual, its respected and celebrated across the whole country and when friends are invited it creates a very special sense of belonging. With Silvia’s family all back in Italy, she loves nothing more than spending Sundays in the kitchen with Italian friends she has made here in Australia. Today her friend Alfia shows her some of her favourite Sunday lunch recipes.

Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

Charlotte’s taking her chance in the big city. She just began working for the hottest romance site writing their hit weekly dating article, and her new best friend, Lila, is as fun as she is loyal. She also befriends a coffee barista, Liam, who shows her all the best spots in the city. But dating a new guy each week to write about is making her feel burned out. And when Liam develops feelings for her, Charlotte will need to decide whether her work is more important than her chance at love.

When the network announces that her television therapy show is changing to a tabloid shock-fest, a straight laced and caring psychologist returns to her hometown and reunites with her high school sweetheart while finally realizing that having someone to share a life with is more important than fame and the excitement of the city.

A young girl struggling with grief and a lonely woman who has shut herself off from the world find their lives unexpectedly intertwined. As the magic of Christmas weaves through their hearts, they discover that love, forgiveness, and second chances are the greatest gifts of all.

Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.

Liam, a fireman, and Amy, a quilting teacher, team up to make a Christmas quilt for Liam's sister's wedding. As they navigate their feelings for each other, they must decide what is truly important in time for the holiday season.

Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

The guys have Federated’s 1990 454SS Project Truck in house and they’re doing a ton of work to it. From brakes and shocks to chassis work, this truck needs some love.
The guys tackle a steering issue in this supped up Jeep by replacing the worn-out power steering gear and installing a new power steering cooler. They toss in a few extras for the owner as well.
With a toddler on the way, Kevin and Willie help get their friend’s police edition Chevy Impala family ready by tackling various maintenance issues and doing an upgrade or two.
The guys help a 2009 Challenger owner add a little more get up and go to her car. Willie also sets up a trade deal with a ’70 Cuda owner to help get his car a little closer to restoration time.
We’ve got a bright yellow C7 in the shop today and Kevin and Willie are installing new specialized long tube headers, exhaust and other extras to make this already robust platform even more powerful.

The 1970 Hemi Charger project is completed in the season finale.

The Graveyard Ghouls return with the final assembly of the legendary General Lee which so happens to also be the official screen-used, record holding, freeway jump-car from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film.
Mark isolates himself in the machine-shop and begins the assembly of the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger previously owned by a former cast member.

It’s a delivery day at Graveyard Carz! We jump back and show you every moment in the restoration of our legendary, screen-used, record holding, General Lee from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film. It all builds to a reveal the Duke Boys would be proud of.

With all the distractions out of the way, Mark returns to the machine-ship to finish the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger while master-assembler Dave begins working on the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner.

With Mark out of the shop looking at a potential new location for a Mopar car-dealership, the Graveyard Ghouls begin the drivetrain assembly’s for a 1970 Lime Light Tribute Superbird and our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger.
Mark the the Graveyard Ghouls race against the clock to finish up some last-minute tasks on their various Mopar restorations before traveling north to judge Little Creek Casino’s epic car show.

It’s another reveal day! Mark and Allysa install the graphics on the ’71 Plumb Crazy Challenger and the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner is finished and readied to be delivered to it’s owner. And Mark proposes - what he thinks is - a “brilliant” idea to the producers of the show.

With our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger nearing completion, works shifts to our 1970 Tribute Superbird while Mark and Cousin Dougie build out a 340 engine and Will assists with metal work with George to help him stay on schedule.

It’s a special day at Graveyard Carz. The 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger that has been part of our show since its inception is finally finished and ready to be shipped to it’s new owner. But before they do that, they take it to the coast to show it off at Chinook Winds Casino Resort Car Show!

Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programmes.t: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programmes.d: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programmes.t: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programmes.d: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

Jackson and Vala are transported to a galaxy populated by worshippers of a threatening authority, the Ori.
Daniel and Vala have inadvertently exposed Earth to the wrath of the group of unforgiving deities called Ori.

SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.
Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

Scott and his pack face their greatest enemy yet, with both lives and friendships on the verge of being destroyed.

Kira and her mother take extreme measures to help Kira deal with her dark side while Lydia is surprised at Eichen House.
As Scott tries to put his pack back together, Malia and a new ally set out to rescue Deaton from The Desert Wolf.

Trapped in Eichen House with Theo and his Chimera Pack, Scott must try to rescue Lydia before it’s too late.
Scott and his pack use a charity lacrosse game in a deadly gambit to figure out the identity of the Beast.
Hoping to align with a familiar ally, the Argents reveal a key clue to the mystery of the Beast of Gevaudan.  Meanwhile, Scott tries to take on the Beast himself.
With the identity of the Beast finally revealed, Scott and his friends are in a race against time to stop the Dread Doctors from implementing their final plan.
Loyalties are tested and new alliances forged as Scott and his friends work to stop the Beast before Beacon Hills is razed to the ground.
With graduation approaching, a supernatural force rides into Beacon Hills and crosses paths with Scott and his friends, while Liam discovers evidence of a new enemy in the high school.
While Scott, Lydia and Malia search for lost memories of a missing friend, Corey discovers a connection between his abilities and the Wild Hunt.
While Scott, Lydia and Malia search for Stiles, Liam and the others throw a party to keep a friend safe from the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam protect the lacrosse team from an attack by the Ghost Riders while Lydia searches for clues that lead her closer to finding Stiles.
Trapped inside the Wild Hunt, Stiles reunites with an unexpected ally while Scott, Lydia and Malia discover Stiles’s Jeep may be connected to his disappearance.
Scott, Lydia and Malia search for clues about the Wild Hunt in a mysterious place called Canaan while Liam and Hayden resort to drastic measures in the fight against the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam attempt to capture a Ghost Rider while Malia and Peter search for a way into the Wild Hunt.
Running out of time, Scott, Lydia and Malia decide to storm the rift in a desperate attempt to get Stiles back. Liam, Hayden and Mason make a deal with Theo in order to learn Douglas's real plan.
While Liam and Theo act as decoys, Scott, Lydia and Malia enact a desperate plan to try and remember Stiles.
With the fate of Beacon Hills hanging in the balance, Scott and his pack face off against Douglas in a final showdown.
As Scott readies Beacon Hills for his imminent departure, a mysterious presence breaks out of Eichen House.
Scott and Malia search for the owner of a unique bullet, fearing that a new breed of werewolf hunter has come to Beacon Hills. At the same time, Lydia must face her own fears of Eichen House.
While Scott and the others desperately pursue a missing werewolf, Melissa and Argent investigate the nature of a strange body.
Scott, Lydia and Malia have to take drastic measures to quell the growing violence in Beacon Hills, while Liam endures his own gauntlet at the high school.
When Scott and the others try to protect two new werewolves, an unlikely ally joins the fight.
Liam and Theo attempt to draw the Hunters away from Beacon Hills.
After a shocking attack leaves the pack reeling, Scott sets out to recruit reinforcements.
Scott and the others must make a discovery before it’s too late.
Scott and Malia prepare for battle while Argent searches for an old ally.
Gerard initiates his final attack on the Supernaturals of Beacon Hills.

When teenager Scott McCall (Tyler Posey) is convinced by his best friend, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien), to join a search in the woods for a missing body, something comes out of the darkness to take a bite out of his side, changing his life forever.

Not aware that he has become a werewolf, Scott (Tyler Posey) must deal with hunters trying to catch him, another werewolf (Tyler Hoechlin) and the pressures of normal teen life, all while trying to get a second date with Allison (Crystal Reed).

Scott's (Tyler Posey) first date with Allison (Crystal Reed) ends up in confusion and turns into a dreaded "group date." Meanwhile, a mystery animal attack has Sheriff Stilinski (Linden Ashby) and the rest of Beacon Hills on the lookout.

With his life in danger, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) is forced to make reluctant allies out of Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien). While Scott tries to survive dinner with Allison's father (JR Bourne), Stiles attempts to keep Derek alive.

A new animal attack raises more questions among authorities. And when Scott (Tyler Posey) and Allison (Crystal Reed) skip school unannounced, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) must deal with the ever more aggressive werewolf hunters on his own.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) come up with ways for Scott to control the transformation in order to be with Allison (Crystal Reed), while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) attempts to make an ally of Scott in his battle with the hunters.

When Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) is savagely attacked by the Alpha, Scott (Tyler Posey), Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) and their friends find themselves trapped in Beacon Hills High School at night where they face both questions and suspicions about each other.

Ann hires press agent Eddie Edwards to boost her career.

Ann helps sober up a comedian who thinks that they had an affair.
An elderly man who ruins Ann's dress gets her a new one, but he keeps buying her gifts.
Ann must slap Barry Sullivan onstage.
Ann's flight to Florida is hijacked.
Ann is selected for jury duty.
Don and Ann head to Hollywood.
Ann's commercial work proves to be more grueling than she could possibly have expected.
Ann takes her responsibility to vote so seriously that it gets her into a spat with her father.
Ann gets stuck in the shower and the new neighbor comes to her rescue.
Don researches the NYPD's mugger detail.
Reuniting the feuding Baumans.
Middle-aged aristocrat wants to wed Don.
Ann is jealous of Don's secretary.
The Screen Actors Guild gives Ann a huge paycheck, and she struggles with what to do with it.
Dinner becomes a loud bash.
Woman thinks husband loves Ann.
Donald buys Ann a small avant-garde sculpture and gets plenty of advice on what to do with it.
While watching her parents house in Brewster, Ann gets locked in the basement.
Ann loses an earring Don gave her.
Ann is faced with a sudden audit from the IRS.
Ann plans a spectacular career for a woman who dubbed her voice in a commercial.
Ann swallows her pride for a TV role.
A stray dog that follow Ann home decides to bite her visiting father.
While shopping, Ann becomes sympathetic to an eight-year-old boy who tries to steal a candy bar.
The United States Air Force hires Ann to recruit women to the WAFS for potential space travel.
Ann's father suspects the worst when he finds Don in Ann's apartment early one morning.
Ann's father turns a rainy-day game of Monopoly into a family crisis.
Ann's father slips and hurts himself, and Donald has to get him to sign an insurance waiver.
While modeling, Ann is hired to spy on a competitor who is suspected of stealing designs.
Ann's cover is blown and she is tricked into photographing rejected dress designs.
Lou wants Ann to direct a variety show.
Ann lands a job as a dancing chicken for a restaurant; she gets stranded on a country road.
Under hypnosis at the dentist, Ann is mistakenly told to buy anything at the drop of a hat.

Snow traps Ann, her parents and Don.
Don writes a comedy sketch about their previous adventures being stranded at JFK Airport.

When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of  a haunted house and a senseless death?

An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical…it is actually Justin himself.

A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities…in The Outer Limits.

A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip…to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

We take a behind the scenes look at Nashville, TN and discover that music really does feed the soul. Featuring interviews with Vince Gill & The Time Jumpers, the Loveless Cafe, and the Bluebird Cafe.

We explore Philadelphia, otherwise known as the City of Brotherly Love. From learning how it all began with our founding fathers at the Constitution Center to experiencing the original Philly Cheesesteak at the place that created it, we explore and live like a lcoal in Philly.

We discover why they call it Home Sweet Alabama with an inside peak in Huntsville! Featuring a behind the scenes look at the US Space & Rocket Center then we discover the haunted spots of downtown with a mysterious ghost walk, then ending the day with some famous Pecan Pie.

We explore Katonah, NY starting out the day with fresh farm & country at the Harvest Moon Orchard all while enjoying a local car show. We discover the history of Katonah from those who know it best and end our day with beautiful music at Caramoor.

We learn why Bowling Green is the corvette capital with a behind the scenes look at the world famous corvette museum! From there we zoom our way with corvette test drive on the race track and then head to some caves to explore the unknown. We end our day with some fresh made ice cream at Chaney's Dairy Barn.

We explore the Outer Banks. Starting the day out at the beach discovering wild horses. From there we go to the National Wright Brothers Monument where the first fliights took place. We top off our day visiting some historic lighthouse and some local cuisine.

We discover Franklin, TN also known to its locals for being voted as best small town in TN. Adventure starts our day, with a thrilling and beautiful ride showcasing the town views in a hot air balloon ride. From there we explore the history of downtown Franklin and end the day with some amazing southern cuisine.

We explore Hoboken and learn all about the charm of this famous neighborhood. Starting out the day with the "Mozzeralla Boss" we learn how to make mozzeralla from the king himself. From there we learn more about the history of Hoboken and its famous residents including the late Frank Sinatra. We end our day with art and fresh made delicacys.

We live like a local in The Hamptons. From paddle boarding the morning away to learning about art and history from the local experts we see everything the Hamptons has to offer. We top off the day with a classic float from the locals favorite spot.

We explore the West Village in NYC, known to most as one of the most iconic neighborhoods in Manhattan. From sea salt cookies to handmade toys and collectibles we get to know the neighborhood first hand through its innovative locals and shops.

We enjoy a day to kayaking in this beautiful naval neighborhood. We learn first hand from local historians the rich history of Annapolis and of adventure in Annapolis. Starting out the day with some great eat from the famous Chick n' Ruths top off the day at the annual Crab Fest!

Lights, Camera, Broadway! We explore the VIP spots of Broadway and learn about how it all started. From a behind the scenes look at the famous Sardis to topping off the day at one of the citys most iconic cabaret spots!
